Selection Process

Selection will be made through Computer Based Test (CBT) / Written Screening Test followed by Document Verification.

  • Computer Based Test (CBT):
    • Total Marks: 120 (Objective Type – 120 Multiple Choice Questions, 1 mark each).
    • Duration: 1 ½ hours (90 minutes) or as decided by the Aayog.
    • Syllabus: (i) Subject(s)/field(s) up to the level of prescribed essential qualification(s). (ii) General Knowledge (including HP & Current Affairs), Everyday Science, Logical Reasoning, Social Science, General English & General Hindi of Matric Standard.
    • Minimum Qualifying Marks:
      • General Category: 45%
      • SC/ST/OBC/Wards of Freedom Fighters: 40% (Aayog may relax by maximum 5% if number of qualifying candidates is less than posts).
    • In case of multiple shifts: Normalization of scores using Z-Score Method (Mean and Standard Deviation Method).
    • Provisional Answer Key will be uploaded; 7 days for objections (fee ₹200 per challenge).
  • Shortlisted candidates (as per merit) will be called for Document Verification.
  • Final selection on the basis of CBT marks + verification of original documents.
  • Category-wise Waiting List/Panel will also be prepared (25% for up to 25 posts, 15% for 25-50 posts, 10% for above 50 posts).
  • Appointment is purely Scheme-based, temporary for 5 years on fixed honorarium under the CBSE Scheme notified vide No. EDN-B-A(1)-3/2025 dated 01.04.2026. Selected candidates are not regular Government employees and can be posted anywhere in the State.

How to Apply

Application Mode: Online only through the official website of HPRCA. No Offline Application Form will be accepted.

Steps to Apply:

  1. Visit https://hprca.hp.gov.in → Click “Sign Up” to create username & password.
  2. Complete One Time Registration (OTR): Fill personal details, educational qualifications, work experience (if any), upload recent passport-size photograph & signature.
  3. Login → Go to “Apply” → Select the desired post (Post Code 26017/26018/26019/26020).
  4. Fill/confirm details (auto-filled from OTR profile).
  5. Select Preferred Exam District (HPRCA reserves right to allot any centre).
  6. Review application → Pay fee online through Credit Card/Debit Card/Net Banking.
  7. Submit and take printout of the application form for future reference.
  8. A candidate can submit only one application against each post.

General Instructions

  • Cut-off date for determining eligibility (Essential Qualifications, Age, Experience) is 04-05-2026 (11:59 PM).
  • Age: 18 to 45 years (as on 01-01-2026).
  • Candidates must be registered on One Time Registration (OTR) portal before filling ORA.
  • Category once claimed cannot be changed after the correction window.
  • Only Bonafide Himachali candidates need to have passed Matric & 10+2 from HP School/ Institution (except Bonafide Himachali).
  • Reserved category certificates (SC/ST/OBC/EWS/BPL/WFF) must be valid on closing date of ORA as well as on date of document verification.
  • PwBD/PwD candidates can avail scribe/reader & compensatory time (20 minutes per hour) after prior approval from HPRCA.
  • No TA/DA will be paid for appearing in CBT or document verification.
  • Admit Card will be downloaded from the website only (no postal dispatch).
  • Mere submission of application or appearing in CBT does not guarantee eligibility. Final eligibility is determined at document verification stage.
  • Canvassing in any form or use of unfair means will lead to disqualification and possible criminal action.
  • The appointment is purely temporary under the CBSE Scheme. Selected candidates shall not be regularized against any sanctioned post of Education Department.
  • Dispute, if any, shall be subject to Court jurisdiction of Himachal Pradesh only.
  • Candidates are advised to visit https://hprca.hp.gov.in regularly for updates, admit card, answer key, result etc.

DBT Note: An additional Direct Benefit Transfer (DBT) amount of ₹4,000/month for Diploma Apprentices and ₹4,500/month for Graduate Apprentices is provided by the Government of India under the NATS scheme. The above stipend figures are inclusive of DBT wherever applicable. Candidates must have an active Aadhaar-seeded, DBT-enabled bank account.

Age Limit

Candidates must be between 18 and 30 years of age. Age relaxation for SC/ST/OBC and other reserved categories will be applicable as per Government of India guidelines.

Reservation

Reservation will be followed as per the Apprentice Act 1961. Candidates claiming reservation must submit the requisite certificate in the prescribed Government format issued by the competent authority. Failure to do so will result in the candidate being treated as General category.

NHPC Apprentice Recruitment 2026 - Selection Process

There will be no written examination or interview. Selection will be entirely based on merit, calculated from the candidates' academic performance.

Graduate Apprentice

  • 10th Class: 20%
  • 12th/Diploma (higher of the two): 20%
  • Engineering/Graduation/PG:60%
  • Total:100

Diploma Technician

  • 10th Class:30%
  • Diploma in Engineering:70%
  • Total:100

ITI Technician

  • 10th Class:30%
  • ITI in Concerned Trade:70%
  • Total: 100

Preference in Selection

Based on merit, preference will be given in the following order:

  1. Candidates from Project Affected Families of the respective Project/Power Station.
  2. Candidates from the concerned district(s) of the State/UT where the project is located.
  3. Candidates from the State/UT where the project is located.
  4. Candidates from other States/UTs based on merit.

NHPC Apprentice Recruitment 2026 - Application Fee

As per the official advertisement, no application fee has been prescribed for candidates applying for any category of NHPC Apprentice posts 2026.

How to Apply for NHPC Apprentice Recruitment 2026

The application process is online only and consists of two steps - first registering on the NAPS/NATS portal, then applying on the NHPC official website.

  1. Register on NAPS/NATS Portal: ITI trade candidates must register on NAPS at apprenticeshipindia.gov.in. Graduate/Diploma trade candidates must register on NATS at nats.education.gov.in. Complete your profile and upload all required documents.
  2. Note your Registration/Enrolment Number: After completing registration, note your NAPS/NATS enrolment number carefully - it will be required for the NHPC application form.
  3. Apply on NHPC Website: Visit nhpcindia.com → Career Section → Engagement of Apprentice → Apply Now. Fill in all required details including trade, personal information, educational qualifications, category and NAPS/NATS enrolment number.
  4. Upload Documents: Upload scanned copies of - NAPS/NATS Registration Form, 10th Marksheet (Age proof), ITI/Diploma/Degree Marksheets, SC/ST/OBC(NCL) Certificate (if applicable), recent passport-size colour photograph, and signature.
  5. Submit & Save: Review all entries carefully and submit the application before 06 May 2026, 5:00 PM. Save/print a copy of the submitted application for future reference.

Note: candidates should apply for only one region/state/trade. 

Important: Applications made through any mode other than the NHPC official website will not be accepted. Candidates awaiting final results of qualifying examinations and those who have already undergone apprenticeship training of 1 year or more are not eligible to apply.

Selection Process

Computer Based Test (CBT) / Written Screening Test of 120 marks of 1 ½ hours (one and a half hours) duration or as decided by the Aayog.

Syllabus The objective type screening test will consist of 120 multiple-choice questions, with each question carrying 1 mark.

i) Subject(s)/field(s) upto the level of prescribed essential qualification(s) as notified in the advertisement. ii) (a) General Knowledge including General Knowledge of Himachal Pradesh, Current Affairs. (b) Everyday Science, Logical Reasoning, Social Science, General English & General Hindi etc. of Matric Standard.

However, the HPRCA may issue a detailed syllabus on its official website in due course of time.

Minimum Qualifying Marks

  • General Category: 45%
  • SC/ST/OBC/Wards of Freedom Fighters: 40%

If the number of candidates securing the prescribed percentage is less than the advertised posts, the Aayog may relax the qualifying percentage by a maximum of 5% (i.e., upto 40% for General and 35% for reserved categories) for reasons to be recorded in writing.

Normalization of Scores (for multiple shifts CBT) Scores shall be normalized using Z-Score Method (Mean and Standard Deviation Method) for preparation of the merit list.

Further Process

  • Shortlisting for Document Verification based on merit.
  • Final selection/allocation on the basis of “Merit-Cum-Option-Cum-Availability of Post” formula.
  • Category-wise waiting list/panel shall be prepared (25%/15%/10% of posts as per rules).
  • Recommendations valid till appointments are offered by the Appointing Authority.
  • Selected candidates liable to be posted anywhere within the State.

How to Apply

Steps to Fill Up Online Application Form Step 1: Sign Up – Register on the HPRCA portal by clicking “Sign Up” to create username and password.

Step 2: One-Time Registration (OTR) – Complete OTR with:

  • Personal information
  • Educational qualifications
  • Work experience (if any)
  • Upload recent photograph & signature
  • Upload relevant supporting documents

Step 3: Complete/Update Profile – Only users with completed profile can apply. Edit if required.

Step 4: Apply for a Post – View available posts → Click “Apply”.

Step 5: Preferred Exam District – Select preferred district(s). (HPRCA reserves the right to allot any centre.)

Step 6: Confirm Application Details – System auto-fills from profile; review carefully.

Step 7: Pay Application Fee – Through Online Payment Gateway (Credit/Debit Card/Net Banking).

Step 8: Application Submission Confirmation – After successful payment, application is complete.

  • Correction window (4 days after closing date) – Fee ₹100/-.

J&K Bank Apprentice Recruitment 2026 Eligibility Criteria

Eligibility Criterion Description
Qualification Graduation from a recognised University/Institute. Must have passed graduation on or after 01.01.2022. Proficiency in local/official language required (studied as subject in Class 10 or 12).
Age (as on 01/01/2026) Minimum 20 years and Maximum 28 years. Relaxation for SC/ST/OBC/PwBD etc. as per Government guidelines.
Training Duration 12 months. Apprentices will be relieved after completion of the apprenticeship period.
Stipend ₹13,500/- per month (Bank's share: ₹9,000/- + Govt. share via DBT: ₹4,500/-). Conveyance up to ₹1,250/- per month. DBT amount applicable only for candidates below 35 years of age.
Trainee Hours On-the-Job Training during normal working hours from 10 AM to 5 PM, as applicable to the workmen cadre of the Bank.

J&K Bank Apprentice Recruitment 2026 Application Fee

Candidates are required to pay a non-refundable application fee/intimation charges through online mode only during the registration window from 20 April 2026 to 26 April 2026. No other mode of payment is available. The application fee is inclusive of GST, and bank transaction charges for online payment will have to be borne by the candidate.

Fee once remitted will not be refunded under any circumstances, including withdrawal of candidature or cancellation of the recruitment process.Candidates should ensure they pay the fee applicable to their correct category, as change of category will not be permitted at any stage after submission of the online application. Payment can be made using Debit Cards (RuPay/Visa/MasterCard/Maestro), Credit Cards, Internet Banking, IMPS, Cash Cards, or Mobile Wallets.

Category Application Fee
Unreserved (General) Category ₹700/- (inclusive of GST)
Reserved Category Candidates ₹500/- (inclusive of GST)

J&K Bank Apprentice Recruitment 2026 Selection Process

The selection of apprentices for J&K Bank 2026 will be based entirely on merit obtained in an Online Written Examination of objective type. The examination consists of 100 questions of 100 marks to be completed in 60 minutes (1 hour), divided into two sections: General Awareness & English Comprehension (50 questions, 50 marks, 30 minutes) and Quantitative Aptitude & Reasoning Ability (50 questions, 50 marks, 30 minutes).

There is a penalty for wrong answers -one-fourth (1/4th) of the marks assigned to a question will be deducted for each wrong answer. No penalty applies for unattempted questions. The online examination will be conducted only in English. The merit list will be drawn district/region and category wise, with candidates placed according to their aggregate marks in descending order. In case two or more candidates score equal marks, they will be ranked based on age in descending order (older candidate ranked higher).

A wait list of 50% of notified vacancies will be maintained for one year from the date of result or till the next engagement exercise, whichever is earlier. The Bank reserves the right to conduct any other test or follow any other selection criteria at its discretion.

S. No. Test No. of Questions Maximum Marks Duration
1 General Awareness & English Comprehension 50 50 30 Minutes
2 Quantitative Aptitude & Reasoning Ability 50 50 30 Minutes
Total 100 100 60 Minutes

Additional Benefits for J&K / Ladakh Domicile Apprentices (on Future Recruitment):

  • Relaxation of one year in age for appointment in Banking Associate cadre after successful completion of the Apprenticeship programme (applicable exclusively for domicile of UTs of J&K and Ladakh).
  • An additional 2.5% of maximum marks (i.e., 2.5 marks out of 100) will be added to the score in the online written test, subject to the condition that total marks (including bonus marks) do not exceed maximum marks (applicable exclusively for domicile of UTs of J&K and Ladakh).

J&K Bank Apprentice Recruitment 2026 Application Form

The application form for J&K Bank Apprentice Recruitment 2026 is available exclusively through the online mode on the official J&K Bank website at https://www.jkb.bank.in. No offline or paper-based application form will be accepted under any circumstances. Before filling the online application form, candidates must first complete their registration on the National Apprenticeship Training Scheme (NATS) portal at https://nats.education.gov.in and obtain their enrolment number. Candidates must ensure that their Mobile number, Aadhaar, and Bank account are inter-linked and DBT is enabled in their bank account before proceeding with the application.

The online application form requires candidates to fill in personal details, educational qualification details, category details, district/area preference, and upload scanned documents including photograph, signature, left thumb impression, and a handwritten declaration in English. Candidates are advised to verify all details carefully before clicking the final "Complete Registration" button, as no change will be permitted after final submission. After successful payment of the application fee, candidates must take a printout of the e-Receipt and the online application form for future reference.

Eligible candidates wishing to apply for J&K Bank Apprentice Recruitment 2026 must complete the online application process between 20 April 2026 and 26 April 2026. Applications submitted after the closing date or through any mode other than online will not be considered.

Submit Online Application at: https://ibpsreg.ibps.in/jkbamar26/ 

J&K Bank Apprentice Recruitment 2026 Salary / Stipend

Component Amount Disbursed By
Bank's Share of Stipend ₹9,000/- per month J&K Bank (directly)
Government's Share of Stipend ₹4,500/- per month Government of India via DBT (for candidates below 35 years of age and first-time apprentices only)
Total Monthly Stipend ₹13,500/- per month Combined (Bank + Govt.)
Conveyance Allowance Up to ₹1,250/- per month J&K Bank
Other Allowances / Benefits NIL Not Applicable

How to Apply for J&K Bank Apprentice Recruitment 2026

  • Eligible candidates can apply for J&K Bank Apprentice Recruitment 2026 through online mode only from 20 April 2026 to 26 April 2026. No other mode of application will be accepted.
  • Before applying, candidates must first register on the Apprenticeship Portal at https://nats.education.gov.in and obtain their enrolment number.
  • Candidates must complete 100% of their profile on the Apprenticeship Portal and ensure their Mobile number, Aadhaar, and Bank account are inter-linked with DBT enabled.
  • Thereafter, candidates must apply on the official J&K Bank website at https://www.jkb.bank.in under the Careers tab by clicking on the "Engagement of Apprentices" link.
  • Candidates can apply for only one District/Area; if more than one application is submitted, only the latest application will be considered. Candidates must upload scanned copies of their photograph, signature, left thumb impression, and a handwritten declaration in English as per the specified format and dimensions.
  • After submitting the application and paying the fee, candidates must take a printout of the e-Receipt and online Application Form for future reference. No change of data is permitted after the final submission of the online application.

Documents to Upload at the Time of Online Application:

  • Passport-size colour photograph (4.5 cm × 3.5 cm; 20KB–50KB; JPG/JPEG)
  • Signature in black ink on white paper (10KB–20KB; JPG/JPEG)
  • Left thumb impression on white paper with black or blue ink (20KB–50KB; JPG/JPEG)
  • Handwritten declaration in English on white paper with black ink (50KB–100KB; JPG/JPEG)

J&K Bank Apprentice Recruitment 2026 Examination Centres

The online written examination for J&K Bank Apprentice Recruitment 2026 will be conducted at designated centres across multiple cities.

The examination will be held online at venues mentioned in the respective call letters. No request for change of centre, venue, date, or session will be entertained under any circumstances. The choice of centre once exercised by the candidate is final.

The Bank reserves the right to cancel any examination centre, add new centres, or allot a different centre to a candidate depending on the response and administrative feasibility.

Candidates will appear for the examination at their own risk and expense. Though the duration of the examination is 1 hour, candidates may be required to remain at the venue for approximately 4 hours to complete formalities such as document verification and login procedures.

Candidates reporting late after the reporting time specified on the call letter will not be permitted to take the examination.

NHPC Apprentice Recruitment 2026 - Eligibility Criteria

Educational Qualification

Sl. No. Apprentice Trade Qualification Stipend
1 Graduate (Civil/Electrical/Mechanical/E&C/CS) B.E./B.Tech./B.Sc.(Engg.) in relevant branch ₹15,000/month

5 Rajbhasha Assistant M.A. (Hindi) with English proficiency / M.A. (English) with Hindi proficiency ₹15,000/month
6 Nursing Assistant BSc Nursing ₹15,000/month
7 Physiotherapy Assistant Bachelor of Physiotherapy (B.P.T) ₹15,000/month
8 Supervisor (HR) BBA ₹13,500/month
9 Diploma (Civil/Electrical/Mechanical/E&C/Nursing/GNM/Pharmacy/X Ray) Diploma in respective discipline ₹13,500/month
10 Electrician / Plumber / Fitter / Machinist / Welder / Carpenter / Computer Operator ITI in concerned trade ₹12,000/month

DBT Note: An additional Direct Benefit Transfer (DBT) amount of ₹4,000/month for Diploma Apprentices and ₹4,500/month for Graduate Apprentices is provided by the Government of India under the NATS scheme. The above stipend figures are inclusive of DBT wherever applicable. Candidates must have an active Aadhaar-seeded, DBT-enabled bank account.

Age Limit

Candidates must be between 18 and 30 years of age. Age relaxation for SC/ST/OBC and other reserved categories will be applicable as per Government of India guidelines.

Reservation

Reservation will be followed as per the Apprentice Act 1961. Candidates claiming reservation must submit the requisite certificate in the prescribed Government format issued by the competent authority. Failure to do so will result in the candidate being treated as General category.

NHPC Apprentice Recruitment 2026 - Selection Process

There will be no written examination or interview. Selection will be entirely based on merit, calculated from the candidates' academic performance.

Graduate Apprentice

  • 10th Class: 20%
  • 12th/Diploma (higher of the two): 20%
  • Engineering/Graduation/PG:60%
  • Total:100

Diploma Technician

  • 10th Class:30%
  • Diploma in Engineering:70%
  • Total:100

ITI Technician

  • 10th Class:30%
  • ITI in Concerned Trade:70%
  • Total: 100

Preference in Selection

Based on merit, preference will be given in the following order:

  1. Candidates from Project Affected Families of the respective Project/Power Station.
  2. Candidates from the concerned district(s) of the State/UT where the project is located.
  3. Candidates from the State/UT where the project is located.
  4. Candidates from other States/UTs based on merit.

NHPC Apprentice Recruitment 2026 - Application Fee

As per the official advertisement, no application fee has been prescribed for candidates applying for any category of NHPC Apprentice posts 2026.

How to Apply for NHPC Apprentice Recruitment 2026

The application process is online only and consists of two steps - first registering on the NAPS/NATS portal, then applying on the NHPC official website.

  1. Register on NAPS/NATS Portal: ITI trade candidates must register on NAPS at apprenticeshipindia.gov.in. Graduate/Diploma trade candidates must register on NATS at nats.education.gov.in. Complete your profile and upload all required documents.
  2. Note your Registration/Enrolment Number: After completing registration, note your NAPS/NATS enrolment number carefully - it will be required for the NHPC application form.
  3. Apply on NHPC Website: Visit nhpcindia.com → Career Section → Engagement of Apprentice → Apply Now. Fill in all required details including trade, personal information, educational qualifications, category and NAPS/NATS enrolment number.
  4. Upload Documents: Upload scanned copies of - NAPS/NATS Registration Form, 10th Marksheet (Age proof), ITI/Diploma/Degree Marksheets, SC/ST/OBC(NCL) Certificate (if applicable), recent passport-size colour photograph, and signature.
  5. Submit & Save: Review all entries carefully and submit the application before 06 May 2026, 5:00 PM. Save/print a copy of the submitted application for future reference.

Note: candidates should apply for only one region/state/trade. 

Important: Applications made through any mode other than the NHPC official website will not be accepted. Candidates awaiting final results of qualifying examinations and those who have already undergone apprenticeship training of 1 year or more are not eligible to apply.

Advertisement

The Government of Punjab, Department of Revenue, Rehabilitation and Disaster Management has released this recruitment advertisement for 09 contractual posts under the NAKSHA Scheme's State Programme Management Unit (SPMU). Punjab Revenue Department Vacancy 2026

A total of 09 posts have been announced for contractual engagement under the NAKSHA Scheme's State Programme Management Unit (SPMU). The vacancies span across technical, administrative, and data management roles. Each post carries a specific remuneration and requires a distinct set of qualifications and experience. The tenure for all posts is initially one year. The post-wise vacancy and salary details are given in the table below.

NAKSHA Scheme SPMU Post-wise Vacancy & Salary Details (09 Posts)

S.No Position No. of Posts Remuneration (Rs. per month)

Punjab Revenue Department Eligibility Criteria 2026

Before applying for the Punjab NAKSHA Scheme SPMU Recruitment 2026, candidates must ensure they meet all the prescribed eligibility conditions including educational qualification, work experience, and age limit for the respective post. Candidates not possessing the requisite qualifications are liable to be rejected. Candidates who have pursued professional courses through Open and Distance Learning (ODL) are not eligible to apply. The post-wise eligibility criteria are given below.

  • Nationality: Only Indian nationals are eligible to apply.
  • ODL Restriction: Candidates who have pursued professional courses through Open and Distance Learning (ODL) are not eligible.
  • Foreign Degree: Candidates possessing degrees from foreign universities must produce an equivalency certificate issued by the Association of Indian Universities (AIU), New Delhi at the time of interview or while applying.

Post-wise Educational Qualification & Work Experience

Post Name Educational Qualification & Work Experience Required
Project Coordinator Education: Master's in Engineering / Business Administration / Development Studies / Social Work OR Bachelor's in Engineering / Science or related field.

Work Experience: 1) Minimum 5 years' experience in implementing and coordinating projects related to Central/State Government programmes or public/private sector schemes. 2) Proven track record in data analysis, project management and coordination, demonstrating effective leadership and problem-solving skills in achieving project objectives and ensuring smooth programme operations.
Expert (Land Administration) Work Experience: Retired Civil Service Officers with a minimum of 10 years of experience in land administration, revenue/registration/consolidation/survey.
Manager (Geospatial Technology) Education: Bachelor's degree in Engineering/Technology from a recognized University or Institute in a relevant field such as Civil Engineering, Computer Science, Geomatics Engineering, or related disciplines. GATE qualified and certification in GIS/Data analysis related courses with knowledge of ArcGIS/QGIS and other software related to GIS data processing and management is desirable.

Work Experience: At least 5 years of experience in managing and execution of GIS-related projects. Proficiency in utilising GIS software such as ArcGIS, QGIS and other relevant tools for spatial data processing, mapping and database management.
Programmer (MIS & GIS Developer) Education: Bachelor's degree in Engineering or Science, preferably in Computer Science or Information Technology.

Work Experience: Minimum of 5 years' experience in database administration, encompassing database design, implementation, optimisation and maintenance. Proficiency in GIS-based software tool development, with a track record of designing and deploying solutions to meet project requirements.
GIS Technical Expert Education: Bachelor's degree in Engineering or Master's in Computer Applications/Geo-informatics or relevant fields.

Work Experience: A minimum of 5 years of experience in the development of GIS-based software tools. Demonstrated proficiency in designing, developing and implementing GIS solutions to meet project requirements and objectives.
Remote Sensing Analyst Education: Bachelor's degree in Engineering or Master's in Computer Applications/Geo-informatics or relevant fields.

Work Experience: A minimum of 5 years of experience in maintaining High Resolution Satellite Imageries and software tools like ERDAS Imagine, LPS, QGIS, ArcGIS is preferred. Demonstrated proficiency in Ortho rectification, mosaicking, analysis using satellite data to meet project requirements and objectives.
Data Entry Operator Education: Bachelor's degree in any stream.

Work Experience: Minimum of 2 years of experience and proficient typing skills in either English or Punjabi are preferred. Possession of valid certification in MS Word and MS Excel / MS Office issued by a recognised institute certified under ISO standards is desirable.

The upper age limit for each post under the Punjab NAKSHA Scheme SPMU Recruitment 2026 varies based on the nature and seniority of the role. Age will be calculated as on the last date of submission of application i.e. 15/05/2026. The post-wise age limit is given in the table below.

Punjab Revenue Department Selection Process 2026

The selection process for Punjab NAKSHA Scheme SPMU Recruitment 2026 is based on a screening and interview mechanism. Candidates will be shortlisted based on their educational qualification marks and relevant experience marks as per the scoring criteria defined for each post.

Only the Top 50 shortlisted candidates (based on Sections A and B scores) will be called for interview/technical interaction. The final merit list will be prepared by adding screening marks and interview marks. The post-wise selection criteria with total marks of 100 are detailed below.

Parameter Requirement

How to Apply for Punjab Revenue Department Recruitment 2026

The application process for Punjab NAKSHA Scheme SPMU Recruitment 2026 is strictly online. Applications must be submitted in the prescribed proforma through the official website https://revenue.punjab.gov.in/ on or before 15/05/2026. Applications received after the due date, unsigned applications, or incomplete applications (without photograph, signature, mark sheets, or incomplete in any respect) will not be considered. The step-by-step process to apply is given below.

  • Visit the official website https://revenue.punjab.gov.in/ and find the NAKSHA Scheme recruitment advertisement.
  • Download and fill the prescribed application proforma carefully with all required details.
  • Attach attested copies of all certificates, mark sheets, a recent passport-size photograph, and relevant experience certificates.
  • If applying for more than one post, submit a separate application for each post.
  • If Grades/CGPA are awarded instead of marks, candidates must indicate the equivalent percentage as per the University's conversion procedure and submit necessary proof. Rounding off of percentage of marks/CGPA grading is not allowed.
  • Submit the completed application online at https://revenue.punjab.gov.in/ before the closing date of 15/05/2026.
  • Keep a copy of the submitted application form for future reference.
  • For any queries, contact Under Secretary (Revenue) at [email protected].

Punjab Revenue Department Application Form 2026

Eligible candidates who wish to apply for the Punjab NAKSHA Scheme SPMU Recruitment 2026 can do so by submitting their application in the prescribed proforma online through the official website https://revenue.punjab.gov.in/. The application process is online only, and candidates must ensure that all required documents and information are complete before the closing date of 15/05/2026.

In case of submission of duplicate or multiple applications against a particular position, the latest application submitted before the closing date shall be considered for further processing. Candidates are advised to retain a copy of their submitted application and all supporting documents as they will be required to produce original documents along with self-attested photocopies at the time of the selection process.

Apply Online at: https://jamabandi.punjab.gov.in/req/Recruitment.aspx

Important Instructions for Candidates

Candidates are advised to read all instructions carefully before applying for the Punjab NAKSHA Scheme SPMU Recruitment 2026. Non-compliance with any of the instructions may result in rejection of the application at any stage of the recruitment process. The key instructions issued by the Department of Revenue, Rehabilitation and Disaster Management are listed below.

  • Applications must be submitted online in the prescribed proforma along with attested copies of all certificates, mark sheets, a recent passport-size photograph, and relevant experience certificates.
  • Candidates not possessing the requisite qualifications for the posts are liable to be rejected.
  • Candidates who have pursued professional courses through Open and Distance Learning (ODL) are not eligible to apply.
  • Only shortlisted candidates will be called for interview.
  • Candidates called for interview must produce all relevant original documents along with a set of self-attested photocopies at the time of the selection process.
  • No TA/DA shall be paid to candidates for appearing in the interview.
  • Candidates are advised to check their email and visit the Revenue Department's website from time to time. The Department will not be responsible for non-receipt of intimation regarding call letters or any communication due to technical reasons or otherwise.
  • Only Indian nationals need to apply.
  • Candidates intending to apply for more than one post must submit a separate application for each post.
  • Applications received after the due date, unsigned applications, or incomplete applications will not be considered.
  • The Department reserves the right to accept or reject any application without assigning any reason thereof.
  • Canvassing in any form will lead to summary disqualification.
  • If any information furnished in the application form is found to be wrong, false, or incomplete, the candidate will not be called for interview.
  • Candidates who fail to produce original degree or diploma certificates, proof of date of birth, conversion factor of CGPA, mark sheets, etc., will not be entertained.

UKMSSB Health Worker Female ANM Recruitment 2026 Eligibility Criteria

Criteria Details
Educational Qualification (Mandatory) Candidates must have successfully completed the Basic Health Worker Female (ANM) Training Course as prescribed by the Indian Nursing Council, New Delhi, which includes 6 months of midwifery training.
Registration (Mandatory) Candidates must possess a valid/renewed registration certificate with Uttarakhand Nurses and Midwives Council, Dehradun up to the last date of online application. Registration certificates issued after the last date will not be accepted.
Desirable Qualification (Adhimani Arhat) In case of equal marks, preference will be given to candidates who have:
  • Served in the Provincial Army for at least two years, or
  • Obtained NCC 'B' Certificate.
Domicile / Residence Requirement (Mandatory) Candidates must hold an Uttarakhand State Domicile/Permanent Resident Certificate up to the last date of online application. Eligible categories:
  • Candidates who have passed High School and Intermediate or equivalent examinations from recognized institutions in Uttarakhand state.
  • Personnel serving in Armed Forces/Para-Military Forces and regular employees of State/Central Government organizations stationed in Uttarakhand, whose services cannot be transferred outside Uttarakhand, and their spouses and children.
Nationality The candidate must be a citizen of India, or a Tibetan refugee who came to India before 1 January 1962 with the intention of permanent settlement, or a person of Indian origin who migrated from Pakistan, Burma, Sri Lanka, or East African countries with the intention of permanent settlement in India.

UKMSSB Health Worker Female ANM Recruitment 2026 Selection Process

The selection for UKMSSB Swasthya Karyakarta Mahila Recruitment 2026 will be based on the following:

Merit List: The Board will prepare a district-wise merit list (batch-wise seniority order) based on the aggregate marks obtained by candidates in the Basic Health Worker Female (ANM) Training Course. In case two or more candidates obtain equal marks, the candidate with desirable qualification will be given priority; if still equal, the older candidate will be given priority; if age is also equal, the candidate whose name comes first in English alphabetical order will be given priority.

Document Verification (Abhilekh Satpyan): Document verification is tentatively planned for May–June 2026. Admit cards/call letters for document verification will be made available for download on the Board's official website www.ukmssb.org. Candidates cannot participate in document verification without the admit card.

Medical Examination: Candidates selected for appointment must undergo a medical examination before joining as per applicable rules.

How to Apply for UKMSSB Health Worker Female ANM Recruitment 2026

Eligible candidates for UKMSSB Swasthya Karyakarta Mahila Recruitment 2026 must submit their application online through the official website ukmssb.org within the specified last date. The online application process has three steps:

Step 1 – Registration: Visit the Board's website www.ukmssb.org and click on "Apply Now." Then click on "Candidate, Register Here" to complete the registration. A valid email ID and mobile number are required for registration. Upload scanned passport size photo (max 50 KB, JPG) and signature (max 50 KB, JPG).

Step 2 – Application Submission: Login with your Registration Number and Password. Click on "Health Worker (FEMALE) Examination-2025" and proceed. Fill all required details including personal information, educational qualifications (enter total marks obtained in all semesters/years of ANM course), category, sub-category, district preference in order of priority, and upload the combined PDF of all required documents. Carefully review all entries before proceeding.

Step 3 – Final Submission & Fee Payment: After thoroughly checking all entries, click "I Agree" and submit the application. Then pay the applicable application fee online via Net Banking / Debit Card / Credit Card before the last date of 04 May 2026 (up to 5:00 PM). After payment, download and keep a copy of the final submitted application form for future reference.

Amendment/Correction Window: After the final submission of the application, a one-time amendment/correction window will be available from 06 May 2026 to 09 May 2026 (up to 5:00 PM) for making changes in name, date of birth, category/sub-category, gender, etc. (except mobile number and email ID). The final Edited Data will be considered valid. No further requests for amendment will be entertained by the Board after this window closes.

Note: Offline/hard copy applications will not be accepted. Incomplete online applications will not be accepted. Candidates must possess all required educational qualifications, caste certificates, horizontal reservation certificates and other documents by the last date of online application (04 May 2026).

The Board's decision regarding eligibility, qualification and candidature of candidates will be final. All information related to the selection will be published on the Board's website www.ukmssb.org only; candidates must regularly check the website.

Candidates spreading misleading information related to the examination will face action under Uttarakhand Competitive Examination (Prevention of Unfair Means in Recruitment) Act-2023. Candidates can contact the Board for technical issues via email [email protected] or phone 0135-2665366.

DBT Note: An additional Direct Benefit Transfer (DBT) amount of ₹4,000/month for Diploma Apprentices and ₹4,500/month for Graduate Apprentices is provided by the Government of India under the NATS scheme. The above stipend figures are inclusive of DBT wherever applicable. Candidates must have an active Aadhaar-seeded, DBT-enabled bank account.

Age Limit

Candidates must be between 18 and 30 years of age. Age relaxation for SC/ST/OBC and other reserved categories will be applicable as per Government of India guidelines.

Reservation

Reservation will be followed as per the Apprentice Act 1961. Candidates claiming reservation must submit the requisite certificate in the prescribed Government format issued by the competent authority. Failure to do so will result in the candidate being treated as General category.

NHPC Apprentice Recruitment 2026 - Selection Process

There will be no written examination or interview. Selection will be entirely based on merit, calculated from the candidates' academic performance.

Graduate Apprentice

  • 10th Class: 20%
  • 12th/Diploma (higher of the two): 20%
  • Engineering/Graduation/PG:60%
  • Total:100

Diploma Technician

  • 10th Class:30%
  • Diploma in Engineering:70%
  • Total:100

ITI Technician

  • 10th Class:30%
  • ITI in Concerned Trade:70%
  • Total: 100

Preference in Selection

Based on merit, preference will be given in the following order:

  1. Candidates from Project Affected Families of the respective Project/Power Station.
  2. Candidates from the concerned district(s) of the State/UT where the project is located.
  3. Candidates from the State/UT where the project is located.
  4. Candidates from other States/UTs based on merit.

NHPC Apprentice Recruitment 2026 - Application Fee

As per the official advertisement, no application fee has been prescribed for candidates applying for any category of NHPC Apprentice posts 2026.

How to Apply for NHPC Apprentice Recruitment 2026

The application process is online only and consists of two steps - first registering on the NAPS/NATS portal, then applying on the NHPC official website.

  1. Register on NAPS/NATS Portal: ITI trade candidates must register on NAPS at apprenticeshipindia.gov.in. Graduate/Diploma trade candidates must register on NATS at nats.education.gov.in. Complete your profile and upload all required documents.
  2. Note your Registration/Enrolment Number: After completing registration, note your NAPS/NATS enrolment number carefully - it will be required for the NHPC application form.
  3. Apply on NHPC Website: Visit nhpcindia.com → Career Section → Engagement of Apprentice → Apply Now. Fill in all required details including trade, personal information, educational qualifications, category and NAPS/NATS enrolment number.
  4. Upload Documents: Upload scanned copies of - NAPS/NATS Registration Form, 10th Marksheet (Age proof), ITI/Diploma/Degree Marksheets, SC/ST/OBC(NCL) Certificate (if applicable), recent passport-size colour photograph, and signature.
  5. Submit & Save: Review all entries carefully and submit the application before 06 May 2026, 5:00 PM. Save/print a copy of the submitted application for future reference.

Note: candidates should apply for only one region/state/trade. 

Important: Applications made through any mode other than the NHPC official website will not be accepted. Candidates awaiting final results of qualifying examinations and those who have already undergone apprenticeship training of 1 year or more are not eligible to apply.

AIIMS Rishikesh Faculty Recruitment 2026 Eligibility Criteria

Professor - Medical Candidates: A medical qualification included in Schedule I, II, or Part II of the Third Schedule of the Indian Medical Council Act, 1956 along with a postgraduate degree such as MD/MS or equivalent in the respective discipline. For surgical super-specialties, M.Ch. is required; for medical super-specialties, D.M. is required (2, 3, or 5-year recognized course). Experience required: 14 years after MD/MS, or 12 years after D.M./M.Ch. (2 or 5-year course after MBBS), or 11 years after a 3-year D.M./M.Ch. Non-Medical Candidates: Master's degree + Doctorate degree from a recognized university + 14 years of teaching/research experience after obtaining the doctorate.

Additional Professor - Medical Candidates: Same basic qualifications as Professor (Medical). Experience: 10 years after MD/MS; for super-specialty disciplines, 8 years after D.M./M.Ch. (2 or 5-year course), or 7 years after 3-year D.M./M.Ch. Non-Medical Candidates: Same as Professor (Non-Medical) + 10 years of experience after the doctorate.

Associate Professor - Medical Candidates (General Disciplines): Same as Professor (Medical) + 6 years of experience after MD/MS. For super-specialty disciplines, 4 years after D.M./M.Ch. (2 or 5-year course), or 3 years after 3-year D.M./M.Ch. Non-Medical Candidates: Same as Professor (Non-Medical) + 6 years of experience after the doctorate.

Assistant Professor - Medical Candidates (General Disciplines): Same as Professor (Medical) + 3 years of experience after MD/MS. For super-specialty disciplines, 1 year after D.M./M.Ch. (2 or 5-year course after MBBS); no experience required for candidates with 3-year D.M./M.Ch. Non-Medical Candidates: Same as Professor (Non-Medical) + 3 years of experience after the doctorate.

Hospital Administration Department: A medical qualification under Schedule I & II or Part II of the Third Schedule of the Indian Medical Council Act, 1956, along with MD in Hospital Administration or a Master's Degree in Hospital Administration (MHA) from an MCI recognized institution. Experience varies by post: 14 years (Professor), 10 years (Additional Professor), 6 years (Associate Professor), or 3 years (Assistant Professor) after obtaining the postgraduate degree.

How to Apply for AIIMS Rishikesh Faculty Recruitment 2026

  • Eligible candidates satisfying all the eligibility criteria can apply through Online Mode only via the official AIIMS Rishikesh website https://aiimsrishikesh.edu.in.
  • The online application portal opened on 18 April 2026 at 10:00 hours and will automatically close on 18 May 2026 at 17:30 hours.
  • Candidates wishing to apply for more than one post must fill a separate online application form and pay a separate application fee for each post.
  • No documents, including the online application form, are required to be sent by post in advance.
  • Applicants should take a printout of their complete, signed application form and bring it to the interview along with originals and self-attested photocopies of all relevant certificates.
  • Candidates currently employed in Central/State Government organisations, PSUs, or Autonomous Bodies must inform their employer about their application and must produce a No Objection Certificate (NOC) at the time of interview and a Relieving Certificate from their present employer before joining the institute if selected.
  • All updates regarding the recruitment process will be published on the institute's website only, so candidates are advised to check it regularly.

Documents to be brought at the time of Interview:

  • Age proof and Aadhar Card
  • Residence proof
  • Qualification proof (degree and mark sheet)
  • NOC from present employer (for candidates working in Central/State Government / Semi Government Autonomous Institutions)
  • Caste/Category Certificate for ST/SC/OBC/EWS/PwBD (in the format prescribed by Government of India)
  • Experience certificate
  • Dental / Medical council registration
  • List of publications in indexed journals
  • Proof of payment of application fee
  • Any other relevant document to support your candidature

AIIMS Rishikesh Faculty Recruitment 2026 - Terms & Conditions

  • Candidates selected for faculty posts at AIIMS Rishikesh must comply with all terms and conditions as specified in the official notification.
  • The appointment is full time, and private practice of any type is strictly prohibited. The probation period is two years, and extension for date of joining will not be granted except in exceptional circumstances as decided by AIIMS administration.
  • All candidates must conform to the rules of conduct and discipline applicable to institute employees.
  • Candidates should not have been convicted by any court of law. Any false information or willful suppression of material facts in the application may result in removal from service and any other action deemed fit by the appointing authority.
  • All qualifications must be registered with MCI/NMC/DCI wherever applicable. Requisite experience may be relaxed as per rules for SC/ST candidates only.
  • Canvassing of any kind will lead to immediate disqualification. The Executive Director of AIIMS Rishikesh reserves the right to make any amendment, cancellation, withdrawal, or changes to the advertisement in whole or in part without assigning any reason or prior notice. All disputes are subject to the jurisdiction of the Court of Law in Dehradun.

NFC Recruitment 2026 Application Fee

Candidates are required to pay the application fee through online mode only via BharatKosh / Non-Tax Receipt Portal (NTRP) at bharatkosh.gov.in before initiating the online application. Fee once paid is non-refundable under any circumstances. Candidates must enter the fee payment details in the 'Details of Fee Paid' column of the application form.

Post Code Post Name Application Fee Fee Exemption
12601 Scientific Officer (C) – GDMO ₹500/- SC / ST, Women
12602 Nurse (A) ₹150/- SC / ST, PwBD, Women
12603 Scientific Assistant (B) – Radiographer ₹150/- SC / ST, Women
12604 Scientific Assistant (B) – Pathology Technician ₹150/- SC / ST, Women
12605 Pharmacist (B) ₹100/- SC / ST, PwBD, Women

NFC Recruitment 2026 Selection Process

The selection process for NFC Recruitment 2026 varies by post code. Candidates are advised to check the official notification for complete details on the examination pattern, syllabus, and qualifying criteria.

Post Codes Stage Details
12601, 12603, 12604 Screening Test (if required) 75 MCQs, 90 minutes, +3 for correct / –1 for incorrect. Conducted only if response is large, to shortlist candidates for interview.
Personal Interview Final selection based on Personal Interview performance.
12602, 12605, 12606 Stage 1 – Preliminary Test 1 hour, OMR-based, 50 MCQs – Mathematics (20), Science (20), General Awareness (10). +3 for correct / –1 for incorrect. Cut-off: 40% (General), 30% (Reserved categories).
Stage 2 – Advanced Test 2 hours, 50 MCQs from relevant discipline. +3 for correct / –1 for incorrect. Cut-off: 30% (General), 20% (Reserved). Merit list prepared based on Stage 2 marks only. Both stages conducted in a single session as Section A & B.
Stage 3 – Skill Test Go/No-Go basis. Up to 5 times the number of vacancies shortlisted from Stage 2. Candidates clearing Skill Test empanelled in order of Stage 2 merit.

How to Apply for NFC Recruitment 2026

Candidates are required to apply online only through the official NFC recruitment website recruit.nfc.gov.in. No other mode of application will be accepted. The online application window is open from 21 March 2026 (10:00 hrs) to 02 May 2026 (17:00 hrs). Candidates applying for more than one post must submit separate applications for each post. A copy of the submitted application will be sent to the registered email ID in PDF format — candidates must preserve it till the selection process is completed.

  • Visit the official NFC recruitment website recruit.nfc.gov.in and read the advertisement carefully before filling the application.
  • Pay the application fee (if applicable) through BharatKosh / NTRP at bharatkosh.gov.in before initiating the online application.
  • Keep all required documents ready in PDF/JPEG format for uploading: SSC/10th Certificate, HSC/12th Certificate, Qualifying Degree/Diploma/Certificate, Registration Certificate, Caste/PwBD/EWS Certificate (if applicable), Experience/Training Certificate (if applicable), Application Fee Payment Receipt, Passport-size photograph (JPEG, 165×125 pixels, max 50 KB, white background), and Signature (JPEG, 80×125 pixels, max 20 KB).
  • Fill all details in the online application form correctly as per Matriculation certificate.
  • Enter fee payment details in the 'Details of Fee Paid' column and submit the application before 02 May 2026 (17:00 hrs).
  • Retain a copy of the submitted application till the completion of the selection process.

Important Instructions for Candidates

Candidates applying for NFC Recruitment 2026 must carefully read all instructions in the official notification before submitting their application. Selected candidates are liable to serve in any part of India in any constituent unit of the Department of Atomic Energy and may be required to work in round-the-clock shifts in operational plants and areas. Appointment is subject to Medical fitness conducted by NFC. Selected candidates will be governed by the National Pension System (NPS) or Unified Pension Scheme (UPS) as notified by the Government.

  • Only Indian citizens are eligible to apply.
  • All qualifications must be recognized by concerned Regulatory Authorities in India.
  • Only one application per post; separate applications are required for each post if applying for multiple posts.
  • After final submission, no request for change or correction will be entertained under any circumstances.
  • Candidates working in Government / PSU / Autonomous bodies must submit NOC at the time of Interview / Skill Test.
  • SC/ST outstation candidates called for Tests / Interview / Skill Test will be reimbursed to-and-fro sleeper class / second-class railway fare by shortest route (subject to production of tickets); fare for first 30 km shall be borne by candidates.
  • Select list / Wait list validity is one year from the date of publication of results.
  • Candidates must regularly check www.nfc.gov.in for all updates; no information will be sent by post or courier.
  • Any dispute will be subject to the Courts having jurisdiction in Hyderabad only.
  • Beware of fraudulent recruitment advertisements forging NFC/DAE name or logo; NFC does not ask for any payment other than the prescribed application fee.
  • For clarification, contact: [email protected] (with Registration Number, registered email ID, mobile number, name, date of birth, and post applied for).

IGM Noida Recruitment 2026 Eligibility Criteria

  • Supervisor (Assay/T.O.-Mechanical/Electrical/Metallurgy): Candidates must possess a 1st class full-time Diploma in Engineering in the relevant stream (Chemical/Mechanical/Electrical/Metallurgy) from a recognized institution, or higher qualification i.e. B.Tech/B.E./B.Sc. (Engineering) in the relevant discipline.
  • Engraver (Sculpture/Metal Works): Candidates must hold a Bachelor of Fine Arts (Sculpture or Metal Works) with at least 55% marks from a recognized institution.
  • Jr. Office Assistant & Jr. Bullion Assistant: Candidates must be a Graduate in any discipline with computer knowledge and typing speed of English @ 40 w.p.m. / Hindi @ 30 w.p.m.
  • Jr. Hindi Typist: Candidates must be a Graduate in any discipline with computer knowledge and Hindi typing speed @ 30 w.p.m.
  • Laboratory Assistant: Candidates must hold a B.Sc. with Chemistry as a major subject with at least 55% marks.
  • Jr. Technician (all trades): Candidates must hold a full-time ITI certificate recognized by NCVT/SCVT in the relevant trade (Fitter/Turner/Electrician/Carpentry/Melter/Chemical Plant Operator/Goldsmith).
  • Age Limit: Minimum 18 years; maximum 25 years for Jr. Technician posts, 28 years for B-3/B-4 level posts, and 30 years for Supervisor posts, as on the closing date of online application. Age relaxation is provided for SC/ST (5 years), OBC-NCL (3 years), PwBD (10–15 years), and Ex-Servicemen as per Government of India rules.

IGM Noida Recruitment 2026 Salary

  • Selected candidates under IGM Noida Recruitment 2026 will be appointed on regular posts with pay scales as per the company's pay structure along with applicable allowances.
  • Pay Scale Details: Supervisor posts carry Level S-1 pay matrix ₹27,600–95,910; Engraver and Jr. Office/Bullion Assistant/Lab Assistant posts carry Level B-3 ₹21,540–77,160 or Level B-4 ₹23,910–85,570; and Junior Technician posts carry Level W-1 ₹18,780–67,390. Selected candidates will be placed on probation for one year, extendable by a further one year at the discretion of the company.

IGM Noida Recruitment 2026 Application Fees

  • As per the IGM Recruitment 2026 advertisement, candidates belonging to UR, EWS and OBC categories must pay a non-refundable fee of ₹1000/- (inclusive of GST).
  • SC/ST and PwBD candidates are exempted from payment of the application fee but are required to pay a non-refundable fee of ₹200/- towards service expenses.
  • Payment can be made online through Debit Cards, Credit Cards, Internet Banking, or UPI. Fee once paid is non-refundable under any circumstances.

IGM Noida Recruitment 2026 Selection Process

  • The IGM Noida Recruitment 2026 selection process will be conducted through an online Computer Based Test (CBT) of objective type, followed by a Typing/Skill Test for certain posts, and a final merit list based on CBT performance.
  • For Supervisor posts (S-1 Level): A single-phase CBT of 150 marks in 120 minutes consisting of General Arithmetic (25 marks), Logical Reasoning (20 marks), and Technical/Professional knowledge in the relevant trade (105 marks).
  • For Jr. Office Assistant, Jr. Bullion Assistant & Jr. Hindi Typist (B-3 Level): A CBT of 150 marks in 120 minutes comprising General Awareness (30), Computer Knowledge (30), English Language Skills (30), Numerical Aptitude (30), and Reasoning Aptitude (30), followed by a Typing Test (English @ 40 w.p.m. or Hindi @ 30 w.p.m.). Final merit is based on CBT performance only.
  • For Jr. Technician posts (W-1 Level): A single-phase CBT of 120 marks in 120 minutes comprising General Arithmetic (20 marks), Logical Reasoning (15 marks), and Technical/Professional knowledge in the relevant trade (85 marks).
  • Minimum Qualifying Marks: General/EWS category – 55%; OBC – 50%; SC/ST – 45%. There is no negative marking.

The online application process for India Government Mint IGM Recruitment 2026 will start from 28th March 2026 and the last date to submit the IGM online application form is 27th April 2026. Candidates must visit the official website igmnoida.spmcil.com, open the career page and complete their IGM Recruitment 2026 Application Form within the given dates.

While filling the India Government Mint application form 2026, candidates should register with a valid email ID and mobile number, enter personal and educational details, upload scanned documents, pay the examination fee (if applicable) and finally submit and download the IGM online form for future reference.

How to Apply for India Government Mint IGM Recruitment 2026

Candidates who wish to apply for the India Government Mint IGM Recruitment 2026 must submit their application forms through the online mode only within the specified dates. Follow the step-by-step process given below to fill the IGM online application form correctly.

  • Eligible candidates for IGM Noida Recruitment 2026 must complete the online application through the company's official website within the specified dates.
  • Step 1 – Visit Official Website: Go to http://igmnoida.spmcil.com, click on "Discover SPMCIL" and navigate to the CAREERS page to find the IGM Recruitment 2026 link.
  • Step 2 – Registration: Register on the portal using a valid mobile number and email ID, create login credentials, and proceed to the IGM online application form 2026.
  • Step 3 – Fill Application Form: Enter personal details, address, educational qualifications, category, unit preference (Mumbai/Kolkata/Hyderabad/Noida), and post applied for carefully, ensuring all data matches your original certificates.
  • Step 4 – Upload Documents: Upload scanned copies of your recent passport-size photograph (JPG/JPEG, 20–50 KB, 4.5×3.5 cm), signature (10–20 KB), left thumb impression (20–50 KB), handwritten declaration, and other required certificates (educational, caste, PwBD, Ex-SM, etc.) in the prescribed format and size as per instructions in the IGM notification 2026.

Candidates are required to apply online only through the official NFC recruitment website recruit.nfc.gov.in. No other mode of application will be accepted.   • Retain a copy of the submitted application till the completion of the selection process.

Candidates applying for NFC Recruitment 2026 must carefully read all instructions in the official notification before submitting their application. Selected candidates are liable to serve in any part of India in any constituent unit of the Department of Atomic Energy and may be required to work in round-the-clock shifts in operational plants and areas. Appointment is subject to Medical fitness conducted by NFC. Selected candidates will be governed by the National Pension System (NPS) or Unified Pension Scheme (UPS) as notified by the Government.

  • Only Indian citizens are eligible to apply.
  • All qualifications must be recognized by concerned Regulatory Authorities in India.
  • Only one application per post; separate applications are required for each post if applying for multiple posts.
  • After final submission, no request for change or correction will be entertained under any circumstances.
  • Candidates working in Government / PSU / Autonomous bodies must submit NOC at the time of Interview / Skill Test.
  • SC/ST outstation candidates called for Tests / Interview / Skill Test will be reimbursed to-and-fro sleeper class / second-class railway fare by shortest route (subject to production of tickets); fare for first 30 km shall be borne by candidates.
  • Select list / Wait list validity is one year from the date of publication of results.
  • Candidates must regularly check www.nfc.gov.in for all updates; no information will be sent by post or courier.
  • Any dispute will be subject to the Courts having jurisdiction in Hyderabad only.
  • Beware of fraudulent recruitment advertisements forging NFC/DAE name or logo; NFC does not ask for any payment other than the prescribed application fee.

LIC HFL Junior Assistant Selection Process 2026

The selection process for LIC HFL Junior Assistant consists of three stages: an Online Examination, a Personal Interview, and a Medical & Background Verification check. The Online Examination is objective type, multiple choice, conducted in English only, with a total duration of 2 hours and 200 questions carrying 200 marks across 5 sections. There is negative marking of 0.25 marks for every wrong answer. No penalty is applied for unattempted questions. The scores are equated across sessions to account for any minor variation in difficulty level.

Only candidates who rank sufficiently high in the online examination will be called for interview. Candidates who fail to secure minimum qualifying marks in the interview will be disqualified. The final selection is based on the combined marks of the Online Examination and Interview, strictly in order of merit. Medical examination and background verification are the final mandatory steps before appointment, carried out at the candidate's own expense.

Jharkhand Home Guard Ramgarh Recruitment 2026 Selection Process

The selection process for Jharkhand Home Guard Ramgarh Recruitment 2026 is based on the guidelines of the Home Department, Jharkhand Government, Ranchi vide Notification No. 5442 dated 20.10.2014. The selection consists of a Physical Test, a Hindi Writing Ability Test, and a Technical Proficiency Test (for Urban Technical candidates only).

After all tests are completed, a merit list will be prepared based on the marks obtained in all the tests combined, and selection will be made against the available vacancies. Selected candidates will be required to undergo medical examination and police character verification.

After being found medically fit and cleared in character verification, selected candidates will be given basic Home Guard training at Headquarters, Jharkhand Home Guard Vahini, Ranchi. On successful completion of training, they will be enrolled as Home Guards and issued an enrollment certificate as per provisions.

No TA/DA will be paid for appearing in the interview.

Stage 3 – Final Updates on Website:
Interview dates, changes, notices, and results will be displayed on the AIIMS Deoghar website. Candidates are advised to regularly visit the official website for updates.

Selection Process

Selection will be made through Personal Interview of the provisionally shortlisted candidates.

  • Shortlisting of candidates for Personal Interview shall be done (on or before the date of Interview as per the discretion of management) based on the scrutiny of the applications against the information, declaration and supporting documents provided by the candidate at the time of submission of online application.
  • The mode of selection may be changed, if required, at the discretion of Management.
  • Final selection will be based on performance in the Personal Interview and verification of documents.
  • List of shortlisted candidates, date, time and venue of interview will be uploaded on MECON’s official website and communicated through registered email ID.
  • Candidates must produce all original certificates/documents in support of their claim at the time of interview.
  • Further scrutiny of the application shall be undertaken on the date of Personal Interview. If any claim made in the application is not found substantiated, the candidate will not be allowed to appear for the interview and no TA shall be paid.
  • The decision of MECON in all matters relating to eligibility, shortlisting and selection shall be final and binding.
  • Appointment is on regular basis in the regular scale of pay. Selected candidates will be appointed against regular posts.

How to Apply

Application Mode: Online only through MECON website. No other mode (post, email, offline) will be accepted.

Steps to Apply:

  1. Visit MECON website www.meconlimited.co.in → Careers → Career Opportunities → Click here to apply Online.
  2. Read all instructions carefully before filling the online application.
  3. Fill all required details in the online application form and upload scanned copies of the following documents:
    • Recent passport size colour photograph (jpg/jpeg, max 40 KB)
    • Signature (Blue/Black ink, jpg/jpeg, max 40 KB)
    • Self-attested scanned copies in PDF format (merged into single PDF ≤ 1 MB) of: Matriculation certificate, Graduation/Post-Graduation certificates & mark sheets, Work Experience certificates, Caste/Category certificate (if applicable), Aadhaar Card, PAN Card, etc.
  4. Pay the application fee (if applicable) online through the payment gateway.
  5. Submit the application and take a printout of the online application form for your records.
  6. Candidates applying for multiple posts must submit separate applications for each post.
  7. Applications without fee (where applicable), incomplete or incorrectly filled will be summarily rejected.

Application Fee: ₹1000/- (Non-Refundable) for OBC (NCL)/EWS category. Exempted for SC/PwD/Ex-Servicemen/Internal candidates.

Note: No hard copy of application or documents is required to be sent. Hard copy of online application is required only at the time of interview (if called).

General Instructions

  • Cut-off date for determining eligibility (age, qualification, experience) is 10-03-2026.
  • Only Indian Nationals are eligible to apply.
  • Reservations for SC/OBC(NCL)/PwD/EWS/Ex-Servicemen shall be provided as per Govt. of India guidelines. PwD reservation is on horizontal basis.
  • Age relaxation: 3 years for OBC(NCL), 5 years for SC, additional relaxation for PwD/Ex-Servicemen/J&K domicile as per rules. Upper age limit after relaxation shall not exceed 52 years.
  • Candidates belonging to OBC(NCL) must produce latest OBC(NCL) certificate (not more than 1 year old) and must not belong to Creamy Layer.
  • PwD candidates must upload certificate showing ≥40% disability.
  • Candidates employed in Govt/PSU/Autonomous bodies must produce NOC from present employer at the time of interview or forward application through proper channel.
  • All appointments are subject to medical fitness as per Company’s norms.
  • Place of posting can be anywhere in India as per requirement of the Company.
  • Canvassing in any form will disqualify the candidature.
  • Mere submission of application does not guarantee selection.
  • MECON reserves the right to cancel/restrict/enlarge/modify the recruitment process without assigning any reason.
  • Any dispute arising out of this recruitment shall be subject to the jurisdiction of Courts at Ranchi (Jharkhand) only.
  • All correspondences will be sent only through registered email ID provided in the online application. Candidates are advised to keep their email ID and mobile number active.
  • For any queries, candidates may write to [email protected] or contact 0651-2483571/2483043 on working days.

Selection Process

Selection will be made through Written Test followed by Document Scrutiny.

  • Written Test: 125 objective type questions carrying 1 mark each (total 125 marks). Duration: 2.5 Hours. No negative marking.
  • PwBD candidates will be given compensatory time of 50 minutes.
  • Minimum Qualifying Marks: 50% for UR/EWS (45% for SC/ST/OBC(NCL)/PwBD against reserved posts).
  • Weightage: 100% for Written Test.
  • Document Scrutiny: After declaration of Written Test result, only the documents uploaded by candidates during online application will be scrutinized by RITES Ltd.
  • Candidates must upload all required documents at the time of online application. No additional documents will be accepted later.
  • Final selection is subject to verification of original documents, medical fitness, and fulfillment of all eligibility criteria.
  • Offer of appointment is purely on contract basis (initially 1 year, extendable subject to performance and project requirement).
  • Posting can be anywhere in India (including North-Eastern region) as per company requirement.

How to Apply

Application Mode: Only Online through RITES website

  • Visit the Career Section on http://www.rites.com and register.
  • Fill the online application form carefully and note down the generated Registration No.
  • Upload all required documents (listed below) in the “Upload Document” section.
  • Make online payment of application fee in the “Make Payment” section.
  • Download and keep a printout/soft copy of the final submitted application for future reference.
  • Candidates must carry the printed application and original documents at the time of selection (if called).

Documents to be Uploaded (mandatory):

  • High School certificate (Date of Birth proof)
  • All academic certificates & mark sheets (10th, 12th, Diploma/Degree)
  • Percentage conversion certificate (if applicable)
  • Experience certificates (in single PDF, chronological order with offer letter, relieving letter, salary slips etc.)
  • Category certificate (EWS/SC/ST/OBC-NCL/PwBD) in prescribed format
  • Proof of Identity & Address (Aadhaar, PAN, Passport, Voter ID etc.)
  • Any other supporting document claimed in the application

General Instructions

  • Management reserves the right to cancel/restrict/enlarge/modify the recruitment process at any stage without notice.
  • Number of vacancies may increase or decrease.
  • Departmental candidates and candidates working in Govt./PSU must be properly relieved before joining.
  • Age, experience and all eligibility criteria are reckoned as on 27-04-2026.
  • Candidates must satisfy themselves about their eligibility before applying.
  • Any false information or suppression of facts will lead to cancellation of candidature at any stage.
  • Corrigendum/Addendum, if any, will be published only on www.rites.com.
  • No TA/DA will be paid for attending the selection process.
  • Legal jurisdiction in case of any dispute will be Delhi only.
  • All communications will be sent to the registered email ID only. Candidates must regularly check the RITES website.
  • Mere submission of application does not guarantee selection.

RITES Limited Assistant Manager (IT) Recruitment 2026 Eligibility Criteria

Educational Qualification (All Three Posts – RG/08/26, RG/09/26, RG/10/26): Bachelor's Degree in Computer Engineering/Technology/Computer Science/Degree in Engineering in Computer Applications/Information Technology/Electronics/Electronics & Telecommunications/Electronics & Communication/Electronics & Instrumentation; OR Post Graduate Degree in Electronics/Electronics & Tele Communication/Electronics & Communication/Electronics & Instrumentation/Computer Science/Information Technology/Computer Applications. The degree must be recognised by AICTE/UGC or the concerned regulatory body in India.

UR/EWS category candidates (and SC/ST/OBC(NCL)/PwBD candidates applying against unreserved posts) must have First Class degree with minimum 60% marks. Reserved category candidates (SC/ST/OBC(NCL)/PwBD) applying against reserved posts must have at least 50% marks.

Minimum Experience: Minimum 2 years of post-qualification experience in one or more areas mentioned in the Job Description of the respective post.

Job Description – Assistant Manager (IT/Network & Security) – RG/08/26: Review and assess HA firewall configuration and policies; evaluate security posture of core network services (DHCP, DNS, VPN); TCP/IP, Ethernet, iSCSI, Fiber Channel Protocol; EDR solution planning and implementation; DPDP Act compliance; cybersecurity improvements; incident analysis and risk mitigation; Wi-Fi and LAN network setup for 100–250 nodes; DLP/EDR/XDR use case creation; Video Conferencing with Central MCU management; SDWAN setup; Firewall Configuration and Network Management.

Job Description – Assistant Manager (IT/Programming) – RG/09/26: Object-Oriented Programming; Software development and system workflow as per SDLC; Relational Database; SAP S/4 HANA, FIORI, ABAP; Problem-solving techniques in the above domains.

Job Description – Assistant Manager (IT/Data Centre) – RG/10/26: Installing, configuring, tuning, and monitoring Windows Server and Linux servers; IIS, DNS, DHCP, Hyper-V configuration; Windows-based scripting for task automation; Remote server administration; VMware vSphere (ESXi and vCenter) and Hyper-V; SAN, backup and storage; batch scripts; infrastructure capacity and performance analysis; regular system maintenance, hardware/software upgrades, physical to virtual migrations; VMware ESXi and Hyper-V virtual machine management; enterprise backup software; hardware and software troubleshooting; rack cabling (power, Cat-6, fiber); power, space, and cooling management; monitoring of network devices, precision air-conditioners, UPS, and Building Management System (BMS) in Data Centre.

Age Limit: Maximum 32 years as on the last date of submission of application (27.04.2026). Age relaxation: SC/ST – 5 years; OBC-NCL – 3 years; Ex-Servicemen – years of service rendered + 3 years; J&K Domicile – 5 years; PwBD – 10 years (in addition to SC/ST/OBC-NCL relaxation as applicable); RITES regular/contract employees – 5 years over and above the upper age limit.

Note: Training period (except on-the-job training), internship, teaching, academic, fellowship, and PhD research experience shall not be counted as part of experience.

RITES Limited Assistant Manager (IT) Recruitment 2026 Salary

Selected candidates under RITES Limited Assistant Manager (IT) Recruitment 2026 will receive the following remuneration. In addition to Basic Pay, candidates will be paid DA, Fixed/Variable Allowances, Performance Related Pay, Medical facilities, HRA/Lease accommodation, PF contribution, Gratuity as per Gratuity Act, and Post Retirement Medical Scheme.

Pay Scale Approximate CTC
INR 40,000 – 1,40,000 INR 16.01 Lacs per annum

Other benefits include Leaves as per leave rules, Maternity/Paternity Leave, Medical facility, Group Insurance, and Leave Encashment as per company rules applicable to regular employees. The pay will be fixed at the minimum of the scale. Candidates from Government Departments/PSUs are eligible for protection of Basic Pay in accordance with company policy. Appointment will be initially on probation for one year from the date of joining.
