RITES Limited Assistant Manager (IT) Recruitment 2026 Selection Process

The RITES Limited Assistant Manager (IT) Recruitment 2026 selection will be conducted in three stages:

Stage 1 – Written Test (60% Weightage): There will be 125 objective type questions carrying 1 mark each for a duration of 2.5 hours. There is no negative marking. Minimum qualifying marks: 50% for UR/EWS (45% for SC/ST/OBC(NCL)/PwBD against reserved posts). PwBD candidates are eligible for compensatory time of 50 minutes. The written test will be conducted at 6 cities across India: Delhi/Gurgaon, Kolkata, Bangalore, Mumbai, Bhubaneswar, and Guwahati (all centres except Delhi/Gurgaon are tentative). Candidates must give two centre preferences at the time of online application.

Stage 2 – Document Scrutiny: Based on written test results, documents submitted by shortlisted candidates will be scrutinized by RITES Limited. Shortlisted candidates will be called for interview preceded by verification of original documents.

Stage 3 – Interview (40% Weightage): Candidates will be called for interview in the ratio of 1:6 to the number of vacancies. Weightage: Technical & Professional Proficiency – 30 marks; Personality, Communication & Competency – 10 marks. Minimum qualifying marks in interview: 60% for UR/EWS (50% for SC/ST/OBC(NCL)/PwBD against reserved posts). There are no minimum qualifying marks required in the aggregate. Appointment of selected candidates will be subject to medical fitness examination as per RITES Rules and Standards of Medical Fitness.

Written Test Syllabus Summary:

RG/08/26 (IT/Network & Security): Computer Networking Fundamentals; Network Infrastructure Configuration and Management; Network Security and Cybersecurity Practices; Cybersecurity Compliance, Governance and Regulatory Requirements (including DPDP Act); Business Continuity, Disaster Recovery and Incident Management; Collaboration Infrastructure and Enterprise Systems; Basic Computer Science and Engineering concepts.

RG/09/26 (IT/Programming): Programming Fundamentals and OOP Concepts; Software Development Life Cycle (SDLC); Relational Database Management Systems (SQL, ACID properties); Problem Solving and Logical Programming; SAP S/4HANA, ABAP and FIORI; Basic Computer Science and Engineering concepts.

RG/10/26 (IT/Data Centre): Server Installation, Configuration and Administration; Windows Server Services and Automation; Virtualization Technologies (VMware vSphere, Hyper-V); Storage, Backup and Disaster Recovery; Infrastructure Monitoring, Maintenance and Performance Management; Data Centre Infrastructure and Hardware Management; Data Centre Facility Systems Monitoring (BMS, UPS, precision AC); Basic Computer Science and Engineering concepts.

How to Apply for RITES Limited Assistant Manager (IT) Recruitment 2026

Eligible candidates for RITES Limited Assistant Manager (IT) Recruitment 2026 must apply online through the official RITES website before the last date.

Step 1 – Visit Official Website: Go to www.rites.com and navigate to the Career section. Read the complete official notification carefully before applying.

Step 2 – Register and Fill Application Form: Register online in the format available in the Career section. Note down the Registration Number generated by the system for all future reference and communication. Fill in all personal details, educational qualifications, experience details, and category information carefully and correctly.

Step 3 – Upload Documents: Upload all mandatory documents in the prescribed format including: 10th/High School certificate (proof of DOB), certificates and marksheets of all academic qualifications (10th, 12th, Diploma/Graduation/PG – all semesters), percentage conversion document (if applicable), EWS/SC/ST/OBC-NCL/PwBD certificate (if applicable), proof of identity and address (Passport/Voter ID/Driving License/Aadhaar), PAN Card, all experience certificates in a single PDF in chronological order (offer letter, joining order, relieving letter, service certificate, pay slips etc.), and any other supporting documents.

Step 4 – Pay Application Fee: Pay the applicable application fee online under the "Make Payment" section. After successful payment, download and print the final application form and retain it for future reference.

Step 5 – Submit Application: Review all entries and submit the application before 27 April 2026. Candidates working in Government Departments/PSUs must apply through proper channel and carry NOC at the time of interview. Candidates can apply for multiple vacancies separately by submitting individual applications for each VC number. For any queries write to [email protected] with VC No., Registration/Roll No., Full Name, and valid email address.

Post-wise essential educational and professional qualifications are as follows:

Post Essential Educational & Professional Qualification

(iii) Working experience of minimum one year as Lab Assistant in a Laboratory Diagnostic Centre or hospital or institution lab recognized by Central/State Government.
Head Constable (Physiotherapy Assistant) (i) 12th class pass from a recognized Board.
(ii) Certificate course of minimum one year in Physiotherapy from a recognized institute.
(iii) Experience of minimum one year as Physiotherapy Assistant from a Physiotherapy Centre or minimum 100-bedded hospital or institute recognized by Central/State Government.
Constable (Nursing Assistant cum Medic) (i) 10th class pass from a recognized Board.
(ii) First Aid Certificate course from St. John's Ambulance Organization or Red Cross Society of India.
(iii) Experience of minimum one year as Nursing Assistant in a minimum 50-bedded Hospital or Institution recognized by Central/State Government.

SSB Paramedical Selection Process 2026

The SSB Paramedical Selection Process 2026 consists of the following stages:

  • Stage I – Physical Efficiency Test (PET):
    • HC (Lab Assistant) & HC (Physiotherapy Assistant): Male – 1.6 km in 6 min 30 sec; Female – 800 m in 4 min
    • Constable (Nursing Assistant cum Medic): Male – 4.8 km in 24 min; Female – 2.4 km in 18 min
    • Ex-Servicemen are exempted from PET
  • Stage I – Physical Standard Test (PST): Height and chest measurement as per category-wise norms (General/UR/OBC/EWS: Male 165 cm, Female 155 cm; chest for males 75–80 cm; relaxations for ST, NE States, Garhwali, Kumaoni, Dogra, Maratha, J&K/Ladakh candidates).
  • Stage II – Written Examination (Computer Based Test):
    • HC (Lab Assistant & Physiotherapy Assistant): 150 marks, 3 hours, 150 MCQs – Part I (50 marks): GK, Maths, Reasoning, General English/Hindi; Part II (100 marks): Technical Subject. Negative marking: 0.25 per wrong answer.
    • Constable (Nursing Assistant cum Medic): 100 marks, 2 hours, 100 MCQs – GK, Maths, Reasoning, General English/Hindi. Negative marking: 0.25 per wrong answer.
  • Stage III – Documentation & Detailed Medical Examination (DME) / Review Medical Examination (RME): Top 3 times the number of vacancies (category-wise) from written exam will be called. Final merit list drawn on written exam marks.

SSF Constable Recruitment 2025 Selection Process

The SSF Constable (Barber & Washerman) Recruitment 2025 selection will be conducted in four phases:

  • Phase I – Physical Efficiency Test (PET): Qualifying in nature; no marks awarded. Events include 1.6 km Race (within 7.30 minutes), Long Jump (11 feet, 3 chances), and High Jump (3½ feet, 3 chances). Candidates failing any event will be eliminated. PET will not be held for Ex-Servicemen.
  • Phase I – Physical Standard Test (PST): Candidates who qualify PET will be screened for Height, Chest and Weight measurements. Those not meeting the required physical standards will be eliminated. Candidates may appeal on the same day to the Appellate Authority through the Presiding Officer.
  • Phase II – Written Examination (50 Marks): Objective type Multiple Choice Questions (OMR or CBT) of 1 hour duration covering General Awareness/GK (15 marks), Elementary Mathematics (10 marks), Analytical Aptitude (15 marks), and English/Hindi (10 marks). Minimum qualifying marks: 18 for UR & Ex-Servicemen; 17 for SC & OBC. No negative marking.
  • Phase III – Trade Test (50 Marks): Candidates who qualify the written examination (10 times the category-wise vacancies) will appear for a Trade Test. Qualifying marks are 50% for all categories. Trade Test is qualifying in nature only.
  • For Constable (Barber): Hair cutting of various types (20 marks), Body/head massage (15 marks), Knowledge of tools/machines used in trade (15 marks).
  • For Constable (Washerman): Washing of various types of clothes (15 marks), Ironing of clothes (10 marks), Knowledge about dry-cleaning of clothes (10 marks), Knowledge about use of various detergents/washing powders/soaps (15 marks).
  • Phase IV – Verification of Original Documents & Detailed Medical Examination (DME): Shortlisted candidates will undergo document verification followed by Detailed Medical Examination. Candidates declared unfit in DME may undergo Review Medical Examination (RME) by giving written consent within 24 hours.

SSC Combined Hindi Translators Examination 2026 Scheme of Examination

The SSC Combined Hindi Translators Examination 2026 will consist of two papers. Paper-I is a Computer Based Examination with objective-type multiple choice questions, divided into two sections - General Hindi and General English - each carrying 100 marks with a sectional timer of 1 hour. There is a negative marking of 0.25 marks for each wrong answer in Paper-I.

Based on performance in Paper-I, candidates will be shortlisted category-wise to appear in Paper-II, which is a descriptive paper testing translation and essay writing skills in both Hindi and English, carrying 200 marks. Marks scored in Paper-I will be normalized if the exam is held in multiple shifts. Tentative Answer Keys will be uploaded after the exam, and candidates can submit online representations within the given time on payment of ₹50 per question (non-refundable).

SSC Combined Hindi Translators Examination 2026 Selection Process

The selection process for SSC Combined Hindi Translators Examination 2026 consists of two stages. In the first stage, Paper-I (Computer Based Examination) is used to shortlist candidates category-wise for Paper-II. Minimum qualifying marks in Paper-I are 30% for UR, 25% for OBC/EWS, and 20% for all other categories. In the second stage, Paper-II (Descriptive) is conducted for shortlisted candidates.

For the final merit list, 50% weightage is given to Paper-I scores and 100% weightage to Paper-II marks. Final selection and allocation of Ministry/Department/Organization is based on merit-cum-preference of posts/departments exercised by candidates through an Online Option Form. In case of a tie, it is resolved by total marks in Paper-II, then date of birth (older preferred), and finally alphabetical order of names. Selected candidates will be on probation for 2 years and all posts carry All India Service Liability (AISL).

Stage Details
1. Paper-I (CBE) Objective type; used for shortlisting category-wise candidates for Paper-II. Minimum qualifying marks: UR 30%, OBC/EWS 25%, Others 20%
2. Paper-II (Descriptive) Translation passages (Hindi ↔ English) and Essay; 200 marks; qualifying based on Paper-I merit
3. Final Merit 50% weightage of Paper-I + 100% weightage of Paper-II marks
4. Post Preference & Allocation Online Option Form to be submitted before FRTA; merit-cum-preference based allocation
5. Document Verification Conducted by User Departments/Organizations after declaration of final result

Tie-Breaking Order

1st Higher total marks in Paper-II
2nd Date of Birth - older candidate preferred
3rd Alphabetical order of names of candidates

SSC Recruitment 2026 Age Limit

  • Age limits for SSC Selection Post Phase 14 vary post-wise and fall into ranges such as 18–25, 18–27, 18–28, 18–30, 18–35, 20–25, 20–30, 21–27, 21–28, 22–28 and 23–28 years as per the User Department requirements.

The exact crucial date for determining age, category-wise relaxations and upper age limits for each post are specified in the SSC Phase‑XIV/2026 notification, and candidates must refer to the post details before applying.

SSC Selection Post Phase 14 Application Fee 2026

  • For General / OBC / EWS candidates: ₹100/- examination fee to be paid online.
  • For Women, SC, ST, PwBD and Ex‑Servicemen candidates eligible for reservation: No fee (Exempted) as per SSC rules.
  • Payment Mode: Online through BHIM UPI, Net Banking, or by using Visa, MasterCard, Maestro, RuPay Credit or Debit Cards within the prescribed time limit.

SSC Selection Post Phase 14 Selection Process 2026

  • Computer Based Examination (CBE): SSC will conduct separate CBTs for Matriculation, 10+2 and Graduation & above level posts consisting of Objective Type Multiple Choice Questions with 100 questions (25 each from General Intelligence, General Awareness, Quantitative Aptitude and English Language).
  • Exam Duration: 60 minutes for general candidates and 80 minutes for eligible candidates using scribes; there is negative marking of 0.50 marks for each wrong answer.
  • Skill Tests: Skill Tests like Typing/Data Entry/Computer Proficiency Tests etc., where prescribed for particular posts, will be of qualifying nature and conducted by the User Departments.
  • Document Verification (DV): Shortlisted candidates will be called by the respective User Departments for Document Verification and final selection as per post-wise and category-wise vacancies.

SSC Selection Post Phase 14 Salary 2026

Pay Component Details
Pay Level Selection Posts are placed in Pay Levels 1 to 8 of the 7th CPC Pay Matrix, varying according to the post and User Department.
Approximate Pay Basic pay as per level plus Dearness Allowance, House Rent Allowance, Transport Allowance and other admissible allowances as per Central Government norms.

SSC Selection Post Phase 14 Documents Required

No supporting documents/certificates are required to be uploaded at the time of online application for SSC Selection Post Phase 14; however, candidates must possess the original documents for verification.

  • Matriculation, 10+2 and Graduation mark sheets and certificates to support educational qualifications.
  • Caste certificate for SC/ST/OBC, EWS certificate, PwBD certificate and Ex‑Servicemen documents where applicable, in prescribed formats.
  • Photo identity proof such as Aadhaar Card, PAN Card, Driving Licence, Passport etc. for identity verification at exam and DV stages.

How to Apply for SSC Recruitment 2026 (Selection Post Phase 14)

  • Candidates must apply online only through the SSC website https://ssc.gov.in or the mySSC mobile app within the application window from 13-04-2026 to 04-05-2026 (up to 23:00 Hrs).
  • Register on the SSC portal (One‑time registration) if not already registered, using a valid mobile number and email ID, then log in to apply for Selection Post Phase 14.
  • Fill in all details in the online form such as personal information, category, educational qualification, post preferences and exam centre choices accurately as per original documents.
  • Upload scanned photograph and signature in the prescribed format and size as specified in the notification.
  • Pay the application fee (if applicable) through the available online payment modes before 05-05-2026 (up to 23:00 Hrs).
  • Use the “Application Form Correction Window” between 11-05-2026 and 13-05-2026 to correct mistakes if required and pay the correction charges as applicable.
  • After successful submission and fee payment, download/print the final submitted application form for future reference; candidates will be provisionally admitted to the examination subject to verification at later stages.

Important Instructions for Candidates

  • Before filling the online application, candidates must read the full SSC Phase‑XIV/2026 Selection Posts notice carefully and ensure that they meet all eligibility conditions for the posts they apply for.
  • All particulars filled in the online application must match the original certificates, and any mismatch detected at Document Verification will result in cancellation of candidature.
  • Application fee is non‑refundable and no request for change in category, post, exam centre or any other details will be entertained after final submission.
  • Provisional admission to the exam does not imply final selection; final appointment is subject to verification of eligibility, documents and other conditions by User Departments.
  • Candidates are advised to visit SSC’s official website and the websites of User Departments regularly for updates on exam schedule, admit cards, results and DV schedule; no separate correspondence will generally be made.
  • PwBD, Ex‑Servicemen and other reserved category candidates must possess and produce valid certificates in the prescribed format at the time of Document Verification to avail reservation/relaxation benefits.
  • Any form of canvassing, use of unfair means or providing false information will lead to disqualification and possible legal action; SSC’s decision in all matters relating to recruitment will be final and binding.

Selection Process

The recruitment process will consist of Physical Efficiency Test (PET), Physical Standards Test (PST), Computer Based Test (CBT), Trade/Skill Test, Document Verification (DV) and Medical Examination (DME/RME).

  • Physical Efficiency Test (PET): Qualifying in nature.
    • For Constable (Driver, Motor Mechanic Vehicle, Gardner, Painter, Carpenter, Brass Band, Pipe Band, Cobbler, Tailor & Bugler): Male – 5 Kms race in 24 minutes; Female – 1.6 Kms in 8.30 minutes.
    • For Constable (Cook/Water Carrier, Barber & Hair Dresser, Washer man & Washer women, Safai Karmachari): Male – 1.6 Kms in 10 minutes; Female – 1.6 Kms in 12 minutes.
    • For Pioneer Wing (Mason / Electrician): Male – 1.6 Kms in 09 minutes.
    • Pregnant women candidates will be declared temporarily unfit.
  • Physical Standards Test (PST): Height, Chest (for males only) & Weight (proportionate to height & age).
    • Height: Male – 170 Cms (minimum); Female – 157 Cms (minimum). Relaxations applicable for certain categories (ST, NE States, Gorkhas, etc.).
    • Chest (Male only): Un-expanded – 80 Cms, Minimum expansion – 05 Cms. Relaxations applicable.
    • Candidates failing PST will be eliminated.
  • Computer Based Test (CBT): 100 marks (100 MCQs), duration 02 hours.
    • General Intelligence & Reasoning – 25 Qs / 25 Marks
    • General Knowledge & General Awareness – 25 Qs / 25 Marks
    • Elementary Mathematics – 25 Qs / 25 Marks
    • English/Hindi – 25 Qs / 25 Marks
    • Negative marking of 0.25 marks for each wrong answer.
    • Qualifying marks: UR – 30%, EWS/OBC – 25%, SC/ST & others – 20%.
    • Marks will be normalized. Merit list prepared on CBT marks.
  • Trade/Skill Test: Qualifying in nature (50 marks, minimum 20 marks required). Practical assessment of the applied trade/post.
  • Document Verification (DV): Original documents (Matric certificate, Domicile/PRC, Trade certificates, Caste/EWS/ESM certificates, etc.) will be verified.
  • Detailed Medical Examination (DME) / Review Medical Examination (RME): As per Uniform Guidelines issued by MHA. Temporary unfitness allowed only for pregnancy. Final selection subject to medical fitness.
  • Final merit list prepared on the basis of marks obtained in CBT (subject to qualifying all stages). Separate merit lists for male/female and each State/UT (All India basis for Pioneer posts).

How to Apply

Application Mode: Online only through CRPF website. No other mode will be accepted.

Steps to Apply:

  1. Visit the official website www.rect.crpf.gov.in.
  2. Click on the link for “Recruitment for the post of Constable (Technical & Tradesmen and Pioneer) 2026”.
  3. Register by providing basic details and generate Provisional Registration Number & Password.
  4. Fill the online application form carefully (personal details, educational qualification, trade/post applied, State/UT of domicile, etc.).
  5. Upload scanned copies of recent colour passport size photograph, signature, left thumb impression and handwritten declaration as per specifications.
  6. Pay the application fee online (if applicable) through BHIM, UPI, Net Banking, Debit/Credit Card or CSC Wallet.
  7. Submit the application and take printout of the application form & e-receipt for future reference.
  8. Candidates should bring two coloured printouts of the Admit Card at every stage of examination.

Selection Process

Selection will be made through Computer Based Test (CBT), Document Verification, Interview (only for Post Code-02) and Medical Test.

  • Computer Based Test (CBT): Single stage consisting of Part A & Part B (100 MCQs, 90 minutes duration; 120 minutes for eligible PwBD with Scribe).
    • Part A (50 marks): Mathematics/Numerical Ability (20), General Awareness (10), Logical Reasoning (10), Knowledge about Railways/IRFC (10).
    • Part B (50 marks): Subject-specific (Corporate Accounting, Finance, Taxation, etc.).
    • Negative marking: 1/4th marks deducted for wrong answer.
    • Qualifying Marks: UR/EWS – 40%, SC/OBC-NCL – 30%, ST – 25%.
    • Normalization applied if CBT held in multiple shifts.
    • Candidates up to 3 times the vacancies (community-wise) will be called for next stage based on CBT merit.
  • Document Verification: Shortlisted candidates will produce original documents/certificates for verification.
  • Interview (only for Assistant Manager/Finance – E1 Level): Weightage 20% in final merit (CBT 80% + Interview 20%).
  • Medical Test: Candidates must be medically FIT as per IRFC standards (C1 category).

Final merit prepared strictly as per CBT marks + Interview (where applicable) + extant reservation rules. Selected candidates will be on 1 year probation.

How to Apply

Application Mode: Online only through IRFC official website

Steps to Apply:

  1. Visit the official IRFC website and register online.
  2. Fill the online application form with all mandatory details.
  3. Upload scanned photograph, signature, left thumb impression and required certificates.
  4. Pay the application fee online (if applicable).
  5. Submit the form and take printout of the application for record.
  6. Candidates applying for more than one post must submit separate applications.
  7. Regular employees of IRFC are not required to produce NOC but must bring Vigilance & D&AR Clearance at Document Verification.
  8. No documents to be sent by post; everything is online.

General Instructions

  • Candidates must read the full notification carefully before applying.
  • Mere submission of application does not guarantee selection.
  • Age is reckoned as on 01-01-2026.
  • Candidates must possess the prescribed essential qualifications as on the closing date.
  • Reservation benefits are applicable as per Government of India rules.
  • PwBD candidates (minimum 40% disability) can avail scribe facility and compensatory time.
  • Ex-Servicemen candidates must produce Discharge Certificate/NOC.
  • No TA/DA will be paid for attending CBT/Interview/Document Verification/Medical Test.
  • Canvassing in any form will lead to disqualification.
  • IRFC reserves the right to cancel/modify the recruitment process without assigning any reason.
  • Any dispute will be subject to the jurisdiction of Courts in Delhi only.
  • All information/updates will be available only on the official IRFC website.
  • Selected candidates will execute a Service Bond (Rs. 2 Lakh + GST for Assistant; Rs. 3 Lakh + GST for Assistant Manager) to serve IRFC for minimum 2 years.
  • Appointment is subject to verification of antecedents and being found medically FIT.

SSB Head Constable Vacancy 2026 Details

A total of 233 Head Constable Non-GD vacancies have been notified for Steward, Communication, Electrician and Veterinary trades through SSB Head Constable Recruitment 2026. Vacancies are distributed among UR, EWS, OBC, SC and ST categories, and 10% of the total posts are reserved for Ex-Servicemen, which will be filled by non-Ex-Servicemen if suitable Ex-Servicemen candidates are not available.

Sl. No. Post Name Total
1 Head Constable (Steward) 2

UR, EWS, OBC, SC and ST category-wise break-up has been notified in the detailed advertisement, and candidates must check reservation, age relaxation and horizontal reservation rules before applying.

SSB Head Constable Eligibility Criteria 2026

  • Nationality: Only Indian citizens are eligible for appointment to SSB Head Constable posts, and no person who is not a citizen of India shall be appointed except with prior written permission of the Central Government; subjects of Nepal or Bhutan may be considered as per rules.

Post-wise Educational Qualification

Post Name Educational & Professional Qualification
Head Constable (Steward) 12th class pass from a recognised Board; Diploma of minimum two years duration in Catering and Kitchen Management from an institution recognised by the Central or State Government; and minimum one year working experience as Steward in a minimum 100‑bedded hospital or institution recognised by Central/State Government.
Head Constable (Communication) 12th class pass in Science with Physics, Chemistry and Mathematics from a recognised Board; OR three years Diploma in Electronics or Communications or Computer Science or Information Technology from a recognised Institute.
Head Constable (Electrician) Matriculation or equivalent from a recognised Board with either (i) two years work experience in the respective trade, or (ii) one year certificate course from recognised ITI/Vocational Institute with at least one year experience in the trade, or (iii) two years Diploma from recognised ITI in the respective trade or similar trade; must qualify the trade test.
Head Constable (Veterinary) 12th class pass with Science and Biology as main subject from a recognised Board and two years Diploma Course in Veterinary and Livestock Development or Veterinary Stock Assistant Course or Animal Husbandry Course from an institution recognised by Central or State Government.

Candidates must possess the prescribed educational and professional qualifications and all required certificates in original as on the last date of receipt of applications, failing which their candidature will be rejected.

SSB Head Constable Age Limit 2026

  • The crucial date for determining the age limit is the closing date for receipt of online applications
Post / Category Age Limit
Head Constable (Steward) Between 18 and 27 years
Head Constable (Communication) Between 18 and 27 years
Head Constable (Electrician) Between 18 and 25 years
Head Constable (Veterinary) Between 18 and 27 years
SC / ST 5 years relaxation on upper age limit
OBC (NCL) 3 years relaxation on upper age limit
Ex‑Servicemen 3 years relaxation after deduction of military service rendered from actual age
Departmental candidates (Central Govt. employees) Up to 40 years (UR), 43 years (OBC), 45 years (SC/ST) as per rules
Domiciles of J&K / Ladakh (01.01.1980–31.12.1989) Additional relaxation up to 5 years (UR), 8 years (OBC), 10 years (SC/ST) as per Govt. norms
Children & dependents of 1984 riot victims Additional relaxation up to 5 years (UR), 8 years (OBC), 10 years (SC/ST)

Age relaxation is not admissible to sons, daughters and dependents of Ex‑Servicemen, and date of birth and name will be accepted as recorded in the Matriculation certificate only.

SSB Head Constable Application Fee 2026

  • For UR / EWS / OBC candidates: ₹100/- (Rupees One Hundred only) as non‑refundable examination fee.
  • For SC / ST / Ex‑Servicemen / Female candidates: No fee (Exempted) as per SSB recruitment rules.
  • Mode of Payment: Net Banking, Credit Card, Debit Card, UPI or other online modes through the payment gateway integrated with the SSB recruitment portal.
  • Fee once paid shall not be refunded in any circumstances, and candidates are advised to avoid multiple payments against a single registration. 

SSB Head Constable Selection Process 2026

  • Stage I – Physical Efficiency Test (PET) & Physical Standard Test (PST):
    • PET – Male: 1.6 Km run in 6 Minutes 30 Seconds; Female: 800 Meter race in 4 minutes.
    • Ex-Servicemen are exempted from PET but must appear in PST, Written Examination, Skill Test (as applicable), Documentation and Medical Examination.
    • PST – Candidates must meet prescribed height and chest standards (post-wise and category-wise as per notification).
    • General (UR/EWS/OBC): Male – 165 cm height, 75–80 cm chest; Female – 155 cm height (Head Constable Steward). Different standards apply for SC/ST, NE States, J&K and other specified categories.
  • Stage II – Written Examination (Computer Based Test – CBT):
    • Paper-I Common Entrance Test: 3 hours duration, 150 marks, 150 multiple-choice objective type questions.
    • Part-I (50 Marks): General Knowledge, Mathematics, Reasoning, General English/General Hindi.
    • Part-II (100 Marks): Technical Subject.
    • Minimum qualifying marks: 50% for Gen/EWS/OBC/Ex-SM; 45% for SC/ST.
    • Final Merit will be prepared on the basis of marks obtained by candidates in the written examination.
  • Stage III – Skill Test (Only for Head Constable Electrician):
    • Skill test will be conducted for up to 20 times the vacancies (category-wise) for the post of Head Constable (Electrician).
    • Skill test carries 50 marks; minimum qualifying marks for all categories including SC/ST/OBC/EWS/Ex-Servicemen: 60%.
    • Skill test is qualifying in nature. Marks of skill test will not be included in the final merit list.
  • Stage IV – Document Verification (DV) and Detailed Medical Examination (DME) / Review Medical Examination (RME):
    • Candidates shortlisted up to 3 times the vacancies (category-wise) will be called for Documentation and DME/RME.
    • All original documents will be verified by detailed BOOs of SSB.
    • Candidates declared unfit in DME may prefer an appeal for Review Medical Examination (RME). The decision of RME Board will be final and no 2nd appeal will be entertained.
  • Final Selection: Final selection list will be prepared in order of merit, category-wise, after completion of Review Medical Examination. Where equal marks are obtained: candidate with more marks in Part-II (Technical Subject) will rank higher; if still equal, senior in age will rank higher; if date of birth is also same, priority based on alphabetical order of names in English.

SSB Head Constable Exam Pattern 2026

The written examination for SSB Head Constable (Steward, Communication, Electrician & Veterinary) will be conducted in Computer Based Test mode with objective-type questions from General Knowledge, Mathematics, Reasoning, General English/General Hindi and technical subjects relevant to the trade. Detailed syllabus, marking scheme, language of question paper and sample pattern will be published with the detailed notification and on the official SSB recruitment website, and candidates are advised to refer to the latest scheme before starting preparation.

SSB Head Constable Salary / Remuneration 2026

Pay Component Details
Head Constable (Steward, Communication, Electrician, Veterinary) Level‑4 Pay Matrix (7th CPC) with basic pay ₹25,500 – 81,100 per month along with applicable Dearness Allowance, Ration Money Allowance, House Rent Allowance and other admissible allowances as per SSB and Government of India rules.
Allowances & Benefits In addition to basic pay, Head Constables are entitled to DA, HRA (or government accommodation where admissible), Ration Money, medical facilities, leave benefits, uniforms and other central government allowances from time to time.
Pension Scheme Selected candidates will be covered under the Defined Contributory Pension Scheme (New Pension Scheme) or Unified Defined Contributory Pension Scheme (UPS) applicable to new entrants in Central Government services as per prevailing rules.

SSB Head Constable Documents Required

Candidates must upload relevant documents during online application and produce originals along with self-attested photocopies at the time of documentation and medical examination.

  • Recent passport size colour photograph and signature in prescribed size and format. >Matriculation / 10th pass certificate and mark sheet as proof of date of birth and name. >12th pass certificate and mark sheet, Diploma/ITI/Certificate Course and experience certificates as applicable to the post. [prepp](https://prepp.in/ssb-head-constable-exam) >Caste certificate for SC/ST/OBC (NCL) and EWS certificate in prescribed format, issued by competent authority. [sarkariresult.com](https://sarkariresult.com.cm/ssb-head-constable-non-gd-2026/) >Domicile certificate (if claiming J&K/Ladakh relaxation), Ex‑Servicemen discharge book and No Objection Certificate for Govt/PSU employees where applicable. [sarkariresult.com](https://sarkariresult.com.cm/ssb-head-constable-non-gd-2026/)

How to Apply for SSB Head Constable Recruitment 2026

  • Candidates are advised to go through the instructions and detailed advertisement available on SSB official website https://recruitment.ssb.gov.in/ & https://ssb.gov.in/ carefully before filling up the application form.
  • Applications must be submitted through Online Mode Only. Applications received through any other mode shall not be accepted.
  • Fill all fields in the application form including: Post applied, Candidate's Name, Father's/Husband's Name, Mother's Name, Date of Birth (in DD/MM/YYYY format as per matriculation certificate), Gender, Nationality, Religion, Marital Status, Category, Education Qualification, Postal/Permanent Address, Aadhaar Number (or valid Photo Identity Card number), Identification Marks, Mobile Number, E-mail ID, Criminal Cases Declaration.
  • Upload passport size coloured photograph in JPG format (less than 12 KB and greater than 4 KB, resolution 100 pixel width × 120 pixel height, white background with 75% face visible).
  • Upload signature in JPG format (less than 12 KB and greater than 4 KB, resolution 140 pixel width × 60 pixel height).
  • Pay the requisite fee of ₹100/- (for UR/EWS/OBC) through Net Banking / Credit Card / Debit Card / UPI. SC/ST/Ex-Servicemen/Women candidates are exempted from fee payment.
  • After successful submission, note down the Registration Number generated and take a printout of the application form/acknowledgement for future reference.
  • Application form can be edited by clicking "Edit Details" button till the closing/last date of receipt of online application form. After submission, no request for change/correction will be entertained.
  • Reporting to Recruitment Venue: Admit Cards can be downloaded from the SSB Recruitment website. Candidates must report to the venue on the date mentioned in the Admit Card with all original documents including Identity certificate, educational qualification certificates, Caste Certificates, Aadhaar Card etc.

Important Instructions for Candidates

  • Posts are temporary but likely to continue. Selected candidates are liable to serve anywhere in India or outside the Territory of India and will be governed by SSB Act & Rules and other Rules amended from time to time.
  • A candidate can apply for only one post from amongst the posts mentioned in the notification.
  • Applications received through any mode except Online Mode shall not be accepted and rejected straightway.
  • SC/ST/OBC/EWS candidates who fulfill eligibility criteria of unreserved category may apply against the unreserved category for posts where no vacancies are reserved for SC/ST/OBC/EWS.
  • OBC Non-Creamy Layer status should have been obtained within three years of the closing date of receipt of applications.
  • EWS certificate should be valid for 2026-27 as per Annexure-III. Family gross annual income must be below ₹8,00,000/-.
  • Biometrics of both thumbs (Left & Right) of candidates will be taken for verification in all stages after attendance.
  • Persons employed in Government/Semi-Government/Public Sector Undertakings should apply through proper channel and submit NOC from their employer at the time of documentation.
  • Name, Father's Name & Date of Birth should be mentioned exactly as recorded in the Matriculation certificate.
  • Candidates should be prepared for a stay of at least one week at the recruitment venue at their own arrangement. No TA/DA will be admissible.
  • Unemployed SC/ST candidates appearing in the written test will be reimbursed fare as admissible under relevant Rules subject to production of Rail/Bus tickets, original caste certificate and Non-employment certificate issued by MP or MLA or any Gazetted Officer.
  • Persons with bigamy/marriage to a person with a living spouse are disqualified. Conviction by court of law or dismissal from Government service also leads to disqualification.
  • Calculator, Digital Diary, Cellular Phone, pager, Whiteners, blade etc. are prohibited in the recruitment venue.
  • The DG, SSB has full right to make changes/cancel/postpone the recruitment without assigning any reason.
  • There will be no provision of reserve merit list/panel. If vacancies remain unfilled after declaration of final result, the same will be carried forward for the next recruitment.
  • Any amendment in the schedule/condition/process of recruitment will be available on SSB official website https://recruitment.ssb.gov.in/ & https://ssb.gov.in/ only.

Project Scientist-II (PS-II) Doctoral Degree in Science OR Masters/Integrated Masters in Engineering/Technology/Medicine + 5 years R&D experience in Industrial/Academic Institutions or S&T Organizations.

CSIR-NIScPR Age Limit 2026

  • Project Associate-I (PAT-I) – 35 Years
  • Project Associate-II (PAT-II) – 35 Years
  • Project Assistant-II (PA-II) – 35 Years
  • Senior Project Associate (SPA) – 40 Years
  • Principal Project Associate (Principal PAT) – 40 Years
  • Project Scientist-II (PS-II) – 40 Years
Criteria Age
PAT-I / PAT-II / PA-II Upper Age Limit Maximum 35 Years (as on date of Walk-in-Interview)
SPA / Principal PAT / PS-II Upper Age Limit Maximum 40 Years (as on date of Walk-in-Interview)
Age Relaxation SC / ST / OBC / EWS / PwBD as per Government of India / CSIR guidelines

CSIR-NIScPR Application Fee 2026

  • No application fee is required. Candidates must report directly for the Walk-in-Interview with their completed application form and original documents.

CSIR-NIScPR Selection Process 2026

  • Candidates must report at the NIScPR Reception Desk on 14 May 2026 between 9:00 AM and 11:00 AM (late arrivals will not be entertained).
  • Selection will be based on: (a) Academic records, and/or (b) Performance in written test (if applicable), and (c) Interview.
  • CSIR-NIScPR reserves the right to cancel or withdraw the offer at any stage without assigning any reason.

How to Apply for CSIR-NIScPR Walk-in-Interview 2026

  • Download the official Application Format from the CSIR-NIScPR website: https://niscpr.res.in.
  • Fill in the prescribed application format with all required details (Name, DOB, Category, Qualification, Experience, etc.).
  • Affix a recent passport-size photograph and sign across it on the application form.
  • Bring the duly filled application form along with all original certificates and one set of self-attested photocopies (Age proof, Category certificate, Educational qualifications, Experience certificates, NET/GATE certificate if applicable).
  • Report at the Vivekananda Hall, CSIR-NIScPR, Dr. K. S. Krishnan Marg, Pusa Gate, New Delhi-110012 on 14 May 2026 between 09:00 AM and 11:00 AM.
  • Nearest Metro Station: Rajendra Place.

CSIR-NIScPR Remuneration 2026

  • Project Associate-I (PAT-I) – ₹31,000/month + HRA (for NET/GATE/National exam qualified candidates); ₹25,000/month + HRA (for others)
  • Project Associate-II (PAT-II) – ₹35,000/month + HRA (for NET/GATE/National exam qualified candidates); ₹28,000/month + HRA (for others)
  • Project Assistant-II (PA-II) – ₹20,000/month + HRA
  • Senior Project Associate (SPA) – ₹42,000/month + HRA
  • Principal Project Associate (Principal PAT) – ₹49,000/month + HRA
  • Project Scientist-II (PS-II) – ₹67,000/month + HRA

Important Instructions for Candidates

  • Project staff engagement is on a contractual basis up to 31 March 2027 only, or co-terminus with the respective project.
  • Under no circumstances shall the total tenure of project staff in CSIR-NIScPR or any CSIR laboratory exceed six years.
  • Only candidates who have acquired the essential qualification and whose result has been declared (at least provisional certificate) are eligible to appear.
  • Result-awaited / final semester candidates are not eligible where the minimum essential qualification is mandatory.
  • Experience will be counted from the date after acquiring the minimum essential educational qualification. Dissertation/thesis work during academic period will not be counted as experience.
  • Part-time, daily wages, visiting/guest faculty experience will not be counted towards valid experience.
  • Mere fulfilling of minimum qualifications does not confer any right to selection.
  • No upgradation of project staff shall be done in the same or new project.
  • The engagement may be terminated at any time by giving one month's notice by either side.
  • No TA will be paid to candidates for appearing in the Walk-in-Interview.
  • No claim for permanent position shall be entertained.
  • Canvassing in any form will result in disqualification.
  • Number of positions may increase or decrease.

DBT Note: An additional Direct Benefit Transfer (DBT) amount of ₹4,000/month for Diploma Apprentices and ₹4,500/month for Graduate Apprentices is provided by the Government of India under the NATS scheme. The above stipend figures are inclusive of DBT wherever applicable. Candidates must have an active Aadhaar-seeded, DBT-enabled bank account.

Age Limit

Candidates must be between 18 and 30 years of age. Age relaxation for SC/ST/OBC and other reserved categories will be applicable as per Government of India guidelines.

Reservation

Reservation will be followed as per the Apprentice Act 1961. Candidates claiming reservation must submit the requisite certificate in the prescribed Government format issued by the competent authority. Failure to do so will result in the candidate being treated as General category.

NHPC Apprentice Recruitment 2026 - Selection Process

There will be no written examination or interview. Selection will be entirely based on merit, calculated from the candidates' academic performance.

Graduate Apprentice

  • 10th Class: 20%
  • 12th/Diploma (higher of the two): 20%
  • Engineering/Graduation/PG:60%
  • Total:100

Diploma Technician

  • 10th Class:30%
  • Diploma in Engineering:70%
  • Total:100

ITI Technician

  • 10th Class:30%
  • ITI in Concerned Trade:70%
  • Total: 100

Preference in Selection

Based on merit, preference will be given in the following order:

  1. Candidates from Project Affected Families of the respective Project/Power Station.
  2. Candidates from the concerned district(s) of the State/UT where the project is located.
  3. Candidates from the State/UT where the project is located.
  4. Candidates from other States/UTs based on merit.

NHPC Apprentice Recruitment 2026 - Application Fee

As per the official advertisement, no application fee has been prescribed for candidates applying for any category of NHPC Apprentice posts 2026.

How to Apply for NHPC Apprentice Recruitment 2026

The application process is online only and consists of two steps - first registering on the NAPS/NATS portal, then applying on the NHPC official website.

  1. Register on NAPS/NATS Portal: ITI trade candidates must register on NAPS at apprenticeshipindia.gov.in. Graduate/Diploma trade candidates must register on NATS at nats.education.gov.in. Complete your profile and upload all required documents.
  2. Note your Registration/Enrolment Number: After completing registration, note your NAPS/NATS enrolment number carefully - it will be required for the NHPC application form.
  3. Apply on NHPC Website: Visit nhpcindia.com → Career Section → Engagement of Apprentice → Apply Now. Fill in all required details including trade, personal information, educational qualifications, category and NAPS/NATS enrolment number.
  4. Upload Documents: Upload scanned copies of - NAPS/NATS Registration Form, 10th Marksheet (Age proof), ITI/Diploma/Degree Marksheets, SC/ST/OBC(NCL) Certificate (if applicable), recent passport-size colour photograph, and signature.
  5. Submit & Save: Review all entries carefully and submit the application before 06 May 2026, 5:00 PM. Save/print a copy of the submitted application for future reference.

Note: candidates should apply for only one region/state/trade. 

Important: Applications made through any mode other than the NHPC official website will not be accepted. Candidates awaiting final results of qualifying examinations and those who have already undergone apprenticeship training of 1 year or more are not eligible to apply.

IGM Noida Recruitment 2026 Eligibility Criteria

  • Supervisor (Assay/T.O.-Mechanical/Electrical/Metallurgy): Candidates must possess a 1st class full-time Diploma in Engineering in the relevant stream (Chemical/Mechanical/Electrical/Metallurgy) from a recognized institution, or higher qualification i.e. B.Tech/B.E./B.Sc. (Engineering) in the relevant discipline.
  • Engraver (Sculpture/Metal Works): Candidates must hold a Bachelor of Fine Arts (Sculpture or Metal Works) with at least 55% marks from a recognized institution.
  • Jr. Office Assistant & Jr. Bullion Assistant: Candidates must be a Graduate in any discipline with computer knowledge and typing speed of English @ 40 w.p.m. / Hindi @ 30 w.p.m.
  • Jr. Hindi Typist: Candidates must be a Graduate in any discipline with computer knowledge and Hindi typing speed @ 30 w.p.m.
  • Laboratory Assistant: Candidates must hold a B.Sc. with Chemistry as a major subject with at least 55% marks.
  • Jr. Technician (all trades): Candidates must hold a full-time ITI certificate recognized by NCVT/SCVT in the relevant trade (Fitter/Turner/Electrician/Carpentry/Melter/Chemical Plant Operator/Goldsmith).
  • Age Limit: Minimum 18 years; maximum 25 years for Jr. Technician posts, 28 years for B-3/B-4 level posts, and 30 years for Supervisor posts, as on the closing date of online application. Age relaxation is provided for SC/ST (5 years), OBC-NCL (3 years), PwBD (10–15 years), and Ex-Servicemen as per Government of India rules.

IGM Noida Recruitment 2026 Salary

  • Selected candidates under IGM Noida Recruitment 2026 will be appointed on regular posts with pay scales as per the company's pay structure along with applicable allowances.
  • Pay Scale Details: Supervisor posts carry Level S-1 pay matrix ₹27,600–95,910; Engraver and Jr. Office/Bullion Assistant/Lab Assistant posts carry Level B-3 ₹21,540–77,160 or Level B-4 ₹23,910–85,570; and Junior Technician posts carry Level W-1 ₹18,780–67,390. Selected candidates will be placed on probation for one year, extendable by a further one year at the discretion of the company.

IGM Noida Recruitment 2026 Application Fees

  • As per the IGM Recruitment 2026 advertisement, candidates belonging to UR, EWS and OBC categories must pay a non-refundable fee of ₹1000/- (inclusive of GST).
  • SC/ST and PwBD candidates are exempted from payment of the application fee but are required to pay a non-refundable fee of ₹200/- towards service expenses.
  • Payment can be made online through Debit Cards, Credit Cards, Internet Banking, or UPI. Fee once paid is non-refundable under any circumstances.

IGM Noida Recruitment 2026 Selection Process

  • The IGM Noida Recruitment 2026 selection process will be conducted through an online Computer Based Test (CBT) of objective type, followed by a Typing/Skill Test for certain posts, and a final merit list based on CBT performance.
  • For Supervisor posts (S-1 Level): A single-phase CBT of 150 marks in 120 minutes consisting of General Arithmetic (25 marks), Logical Reasoning (20 marks), and Technical/Professional knowledge in the relevant trade (105 marks).
  • For Jr. Office Assistant, Jr. Bullion Assistant & Jr. Hindi Typist (B-3 Level): A CBT of 150 marks in 120 minutes comprising General Awareness (30), Computer Knowledge (30), English Language Skills (30), Numerical Aptitude (30), and Reasoning Aptitude (30), followed by a Typing Test (English @ 40 w.p.m. or Hindi @ 30 w.p.m.). Final merit is based on CBT performance only.
  • For Jr. Technician posts (W-1 Level): A single-phase CBT of 120 marks in 120 minutes comprising General Arithmetic (20 marks), Logical Reasoning (15 marks), and Technical/Professional knowledge in the relevant trade (85 marks).
  • Minimum Qualifying Marks: General/EWS category – 55%; OBC – 50%; SC/ST – 45%. There is no negative marking.

India Government Mint IGM Recruitment 2026 Application Form

The online application process for India Government Mint IGM Recruitment 2026 will start from 28th March 2026 and the last date to submit the IGM online application form is 27th April 2026. Candidates must visit the official website igmnoida.spmcil.com, open the career page and complete their IGM Recruitment 2026 Application Form within the given dates.

While filling the India Government Mint application form 2026, candidates should register with a valid email ID and mobile number, enter personal and educational details, upload scanned documents, pay the examination fee (if applicable) and finally submit and download the IGM online form for future reference.

How to Apply for India Government Mint IGM Recruitment 2026

Candidates who wish to apply for the India Government Mint IGM Recruitment 2026 must submit their application forms through the online mode only within the specified dates. Follow the step-by-step process given below to fill the IGM online application form correctly.

  • Eligible candidates for IGM Noida Recruitment 2026 must complete the online application through the company's official website within the specified dates.
  • Step 1 – Visit Official Website: Go to http://igmnoida.spmcil.com, click on "Discover SPMCIL" and navigate to the CAREERS page to find the IGM Recruitment 2026 link.
  • Step 2 – Registration: Register on the portal using a valid mobile number and email ID, create login credentials, and proceed to the IGM online application form 2026.
  • Step 3 – Fill Application Form: Enter personal details, address, educational qualifications, category, unit preference (Mumbai/Kolkata/Hyderabad/Noida), and post applied for carefully, ensuring all data matches your original certificates.
  • Step 4 – Upload Documents: Upload scanned copies of your recent passport-size photograph (JPG/JPEG, 20–50 KB, 4.5×3.5 cm), signature (10–20 KB), left thumb impression (20–50 KB), handwritten declaration, and other required certificates (educational, caste, PwBD, Ex-SM, etc.) in the prescribed format and size as per instructions in the IGM notification 2026.
  • Step 5 – Pay Fee & Submit: Complete the online fee payment (where applicable) through Debit/Credit Card, Internet Banking, or UPI. Review all entries, submit the form, download the confirmation page, and take a printout of the IGM application form 2026 for document verification and future reference.

DGPM CBIC Recruitment 2026 Eligibility Criteria

  • Additional Assistant Director: The post is to be filled on deputation basis. The eligibility criteria including educational qualification, experience, and other conditions are detailed in Annexure-C, available on the CBIC website (www.cbic.gov.in) and DGPM website (https://dgpm.gov.in).
  • The Directorate General of Performance Management is the cadre control authority in respect of Group 'B' and 'C' cadres including the post of Additional Assistant Director in various Directorates under CBIC.
  • These Directorates deal with functions such as investigations into cases of evasion of duties/taxes, human resource development, infrastructure, audit, inspections, legal and appellate matters, systems and data management, and data analysis.
  • Candidates whose applications are forwarded by the concerned Ministry/Department/Organization once received in DGPM will not be allowed to withdraw their candidature subsequently.

DGPM CBIC Recruitment 2026 Salary

  • Selected officers under DGPM CBIC Additional Assistant Director Recruitment 2026 will be placed at Pay Matrix Level-8 (Rs. 47,600–1,51,100) on deputation basis.
  • After completion of four years of regular service in Level-8, officers will be placed at Level-9 (Rs. 53,100–1,67,800) in the pay matrix.

DGPM CBIC Recruitment 2026 Application Process

  • The nomination/application process for DGPM CBIC Additional Assistant Director Recruitment 2026 is through offline/hard copy mode only via the proper channel. Eligible officers must get their nominations forwarded by their concerned CCAs (Chief Controllers of Accounts) along with NOC and all required documents.
  • Applications/Documents received through e-Office of concerned CCAs will be accepted only where the same are duly received in hard copy. Applications/Documents received only through email will not be accepted.
  • The nominations of eligible officers along with required documents, duly attested in Hard Copy, must reach by post or special messenger to:
  • Joint Director (CCA), DGPM Hqrs., 5th Floor, Drum Shaped Building, I.P. Estate, New Delhi – 110002 on or before 12th May 2026 (by 5:00 PM).

DGPM CBIC Recruitment 2026 Selection Process

  • The DGPM CBIC Additional Assistant Director Recruitment 2026 is a deputation-based recruitment. Selection will be based on the eligibility criteria as per Recruitment Rules of Additional Assistant Director dated 31.03.2022 of DGPM.
  • The selected officers may be posted to any of the Directorates/Stations throughout India. Applicants may give the option of 05 Directorates in Annexure B(i) and 03 Stations in Annexure B(ii) in order of their preference. However, the options exercised do not guarantee posting at the said Directorate/Station.

How to Apply for DGPM CBIC Recruitment 2026

  • Eligible officers for DGPM CBIC Additional Assistant Director Recruitment 2026 must submit their nominations through proper channel well before the closing date.
  • Step 1 – Check Eligibility: Download and read Annexure-C from www.cbic.gov.in or https://dgpm.gov.in to verify eligibility criteria, educational qualification, and experience requirements.
  • Step 2 – Prepare Application: Fill in the application/nomination form with personal details, service details, cadre information, posting preference (5 Directorates from Annexure B(i) and 3 Stations from Annexure B(ii)), and all required information.
  • Step 3 – Obtain NOC: Obtain No Objection Certificate (NOC) from your employer/department before forwarding the application.
  • Step 4 – Forward Through Proper Channel: Get the nomination forwarded through the concerned CCA (Chief Controller of Accounts) with all required documents duly attested in hard copy.
  • Step 5 – Ensure Hard Copy Reaches on Time: Ensure the complete application in hard copy reaches Joint Director (CCA), DGPM Hqrs., 5th Floor, Drum Shaped Building, I.P. Estate, New Delhi – 110002 on or before 12 May 2026 by 5:00 PM. Applications received after the last date or incomplete in any respect will not be entertained.

Duration: 90 minutes (120 minutes for PwBD with Scribe)
Syllabus: General Awareness, General Intelligence & Reasoning, Mathematics, General Science, and Professional Ability (50 questions)

For Teachers: After the written exam, shortlisted candidates will appear for a second stage Teaching Skill Test of 100 marks, evaluated by a nominated committee on communication skill, presentation skill, and problem-solving ability. Written test and Teaching Skill Test will have a weightage ratio of 85:15 for the final merit list. There is no Supplementary Test for absent candidates.

Detailed Syllabus 

Civil Engineering (JE / DMS Exam Group)

  • Engineering Mechanics, Building Construction, Building Materials, Construction of Sub/Superstructure, Building Finishes & Maintenance, Building Drawing, Concrete Technology, Surveying, Computer Aided Design (AutoCAD), Geo-Technical Engineering, Hydraulics, Irrigation Engineering, Mechanics of Structures, Theory of Structures, Design of Concrete Structures, Design of Steel Structures, Transportation Engineering (Railway Engineering), Highway Engineering, Environmental Engineering, Advanced Construction Techniques, Estimating & Costing, Contracts & Accounts.

Electrical & Allied Engineering (DMS Exam Group)

  • Basic Concepts, Circuit Law, Magnetic Circuits, AC Fundamentals, Measurement Instruments, Electrical Machines (DC/Transformers/Induction Motors), Synchronous Machines, Generation, Transmission & Distribution, Estimation & Costing, Utilisation of Electrical Energy, Basic Electronics.

Electronics & Allied Engineering (DMS Exam Group)

  • Electronic Components & Materials, Electronic Devices & Circuits, Digital Electronics, Linear Integrated Circuits, Microprocessor & Microcontroller, Electronic Measurements, Communication Engineering, Data Communication & Networks, Computer Programming (C/C++), Basic Electrical Engineering.

Mechanical & Allied Engineering (DMS Exam Group)

  • Engineering Mechanics, Material Science, Strength of Materials, Machining, Welding, Grinding & Finishing, Metrology, Fluid Mechanics & Hydraulic Machinery, Industrial Management, Thermal Engineering.

PGT Written Examination Syllabus

  • Mathematics: Number Systems, BODMAS, LCM/HCF, Ratio & Proportions, Percentage, Mensuration, Time & Work, Simple & Compound Interest, Algebra, Geometry, Trigonometry, Statistics, Pipes & Cistern.
  • General Intelligence & Reasoning: Analogies, Series, Coding-Decoding, Venn Diagram, Data Interpretation, Analytical Reasoning, Directions, Statement-Arguments etc.
  • General Awareness: Current Affairs, Indian Geography, Culture, History, Indian Polity & Constitution, Indian Economy, Environment, Sports, Science & Technology.
  • General Science: Physics, Chemistry and Life Sciences (up to Class 10 CBSE syllabus).
  • Professional Ability (50 questions): Education (22-28 Q) - Philosophy, Sociology, Human Values, Democracy, Integration; Psychology of Learner & Teaching (13-18 Q); Curriculum and Instruction (8-12 Q).

How to Apply for CLW GDCE 2026

This is an offline application process meant exclusively for regular CLW employees. There is no online application portal.

1. Download Application Format: Obtain the application form in Annexure-C format as enclosed with this notification (GDCE 01/2026 dated 10.04.2026). Affix one recent self-attested photograph in the space provided.

2. Fill the Application Form: Enter all details accurately - Name (in capitals), Date of Birth, Age as on 09.04.2026, Designation & Ticket No., HRMS ID & Employee No., Date of initial appointment & grade, Educational Qualification, Date of appointment to present grade, Post(s) applied for, Community (UR/SC/ST/OBC), PwBD status, Mobile number, and Email address.

3. Get Controlling Authority Signature: The completed application must be forwarded by the controlling authority - obtain the signature of the controlling supervisor with designation, and the counter signature of the controlling officer with office seal. The Establishment Officer must also certify the particulars from the Service Book.

4. Attach Required Documents: Enclose self-attested copies of educational qualification certificates, category certificate (SC/ST/OBC), PwBD certificate (if applicable), and any other relevant documents.

5. Drop Application in Drop Box: Submit the filled and forwarded application by dropping it in the Drop Box at the Recruitment Section, Personnel Department, Administrative Building, Chittaranjan - 713331 by 08 May 2026 (17:30 hrs). No application will be accepted after the deadline under any circumstances.

Selection Process

Selection will be made through shortlisting of applications followed by Interview (or Online Examination + Interview, if conducted by the Bank).

  • Candidates fulfilling the eligibility criteria will be shortlisted for Interview (or Online Test + Interview) based on the information furnished in the online application and supporting documents.
  • The Bank reserves the right to conduct Online Examination / Group Discussion / Interview or any combination thereof as per its requirement.
  • Final selection will be based on the candidate’s performance in the selection process, subject to verification of documents and medical fitness.
  • The Bank may shortlist candidates in the ratio decided by the Bank and call them for Interview.
  • Merit list will be prepared post-Interview and provisional offer of appointment will be issued to the selected candidates.
  • The decision of the Bank in all matters relating to selection shall be final and binding.

How to Apply

Application Mode: Online only through the official website of Indian Bank. No other mode of application will be accepted.

Steps to Apply:

  1. Visit the official website of Indian Bank and go to the “Recruitment” / “Careers” section.
  2. Click on the link for “Recruitment of Specialist Officers - 2026” and register using a valid email ID and mobile number.
  3. Fill the online application form carefully with all mandatory details (personal information, educational qualification, experience, category etc.).
  4. Upload scanned copies of photograph, signature and all required documents/certificates (educational, experience, category, PwBD etc.) as per specifications.
  5. Pay the requisite application fee / intimation charges online.
  6. Submit the application and take a printout of the final submitted application form for future reference.
  7. A candidate can apply for only one post. In case of multiple applications, only the latest valid (completed) application will be retained.

General Instructions

  • Cut-off date for determining eligibility (age, qualification, experience, etc.) is 01-04-2026.
  • Only one application should be submitted by any candidate. Multiple applications will lead to cancellation of candidature.
  • Candidates must ensure that they fulfil all the eligibility criteria mentioned in the advertisement. Mere submission of application does not guarantee eligibility.
  • The number of vacancies is provisional and may vary according to the actual requirement of the Bank.
  • Reservation for SC/ST/OBC/EWS/PwBD will be provided as per Government of India guidelines. PwBD reservation is on horizontal basis.
  • Candidates belonging to reserved categories must upload valid category certificates issued on or before the last date of registration.
  • All educational qualifications and experience must be from Government recognized Universities / Institutions and should be active as on the date of application.
  • The Bank reserves the right to cancel / modify the recruitment process at any stage without assigning any reason.
  • Canvassing in any form will lead to disqualification of the candidature.
  • Decision of the Bank in all matters relating to eligibility, acceptance or rejection of applications, mode of selection, etc. shall be final and binding on the candidates.
  • All future communications (call letters, results, etc.) will be sent only through the registered email ID and SMS. Candidates are advised to keep the same email ID and mobile number active till completion of the recruitment process.
  • Any dispute arising out of this recruitment shall be subject to the jurisdiction of Courts in Chennai only

SSSB Punjab Assistant District Attorney Eligibility Criteria 2026

Before applying for SSSB Punjab Assistant District Attorney Recruitment 2026, candidates must ensure they fulfil all the prescribed eligibility conditions including educational qualification, Punjabi language requirement, and the cut-off date for qualifications.

As per Punjab Government Notification No. G.S.R.7/Const./Art.309/Amd.(23)/2026 dated 21.01.2026, the cut-off date to determine minimum educational and other qualifications shall be the last date for submission of application forms i.e. 20-05-2026. Candidates not meeting the eligibility criteria will be rejected at any stage of the recruitment process.

  • Domicile: Reservation benefits are available only to residents of Punjab. A Domicile/Residence Certificate not older than 5 years must be uploaded/produced by every candidate (male or female, irrespective of category).
  • Punjabi Language: As per Rule 17 of Punjab Civil Services (General and Common Conditions of Service) Rules, 1994, the candidate must have passed Matriculation examination with Punjabi as one of the compulsory or elective subjects or any other equivalent examination in Punjabi language.

SSSB Punjab Assistant District Attorney Application Fee 2026

The application fee for SSSB Punjab Assistant District Attorney Recruitment 2026 varies by category. The fee once paid will not be refunded under any circumstances. Fee payment must be made online only; fee submitted through any other mode will not be considered valid and such applications will be rejected.

In case of a failed online transaction, the application will be treated as not submitted and the fee paid will be non-refundable. Applications without complete fee payment will be treated as incomplete and rejected outright. The category-wise fee details are given in the table below.

SSSB Punjab Assistant District Attorney Selection Process 2026

The selection process for SSSB Punjab Assistant District Attorney Recruitment 2026 consists of an Objective Type Multiple Choice Question (MCQ) written examination followed by counselling and document verification. The merit list will be prepared on the basis of marks obtained in the written examination.

There will be negative marking in the written examination - each question carries 1 mark and ¼ mark will be deducted for each wrong answer. Only candidates whose eligibility is fully established will be recommended to the concerned department on the basis of written examination merit. The detailed selection process is given below.

Stage Details
1. Written Examination Objective Type MCQ written examination; each question carries 1 mark; negative marking of ¼ mark per wrong answer
2. Merit List Preparation Merit list prepared based on marks obtained in the written examination. Tie-breaking order: (i) Date of Birth (older candidate preferred), (ii) Higher percentage in required educational qualification, (iii) Higher marks in Matriculation
3. Counselling & Document Verification Candidates called for counselling based on merit; number of candidates to be called decided by the Board keeping in view category-wise vacancies; candidates must produce original certificates and attested copies of all required documents
4. Recommendation to Department Names of candidates found fully eligible after counselling will be recommended to the concerned department as per the available vacancies at that time

How to Apply for SSSB Punjab Assistant District Attorney Recruitment 2026

The application process for SSSB Punjab Assistant District Attorney Recruitment 2026 is strictly online. Applications submitted through any other mode will not be accepted and will be treated as cancelled. Candidates are advised to fill the online form themselves and not take help from any other person or cyber cafe attendant, as no correction will be made in the form once submitted. Once an application form is submitted, no modification will be allowed under any circumstances. The step-by-step process to apply online is given below.

  • Visit the official website https://sssb.punjab.gov.in and click on the "Apply Online" link available on the homepage.
  • Candidates who do not have a Login/User ID must click on "Registration" and fill in their details to generate a User ID and Password. The User ID will be the Email ID provided during registration.
  • After successful registration, login using the User ID (Email ID) and Password and proceed with the online application.
  • Fill in all personal, educational, and required information correctly and completely. Upload a passport-size photograph (or capture a live photo via camera) and upload a scanned copy of the signature. Applications without photograph and signature will be treated as incomplete and rejected.
  • Click on "Save Draft" or "Next", then click on "Attach Annexure" and upload scanned copies of 10th class certificate, educational qualification certificates, and other mandatory documents in PDF format as indicated on the portal.
  • After uploading documents, click "Save Documents" and then click "Make Payment" to pay the prescribed online fee.
  • After successful fee payment, click "Submit" to complete the application process. The complete Application Form will be displayed on the screen - candidates must take a printout and keep it for future reference.
  • The Application Form will be accepted only after successful fee payment. A draft saved form can be viewed and completed later via "Menu > View Status of Application > View Incomplete Application".

Non-compliance with any of the instructions may result in disqualification or rejection of candidature at any stage. All information related to the recruitment including examination date/schedule, Admit Card, examination centre, result, merit list, and other notices will be uploaded only on the official website https://sssb.punjab.gov.in - no individual/personal communication will be sent to any candidate. The key instructions are listed below.

  • Candidates currently in Central/State Government service must apply through proper channel; the application must be received through proper channel failing which candidature will be rejected.
  • Fee once paid will not be refunded under any circumstances. No fee waiver or exemption will be given to any candidate.
  • Applications received after the closing date, incomplete applications, or applications submitted through any mode other than the official website will be rejected.

Other Terms and Conditions

  • You can take the Aadhaar Supervisor exam through this link: https://uidai.nseitexams.com/UIDAI/LoginAction_input.action
  • When you apply for the exam, an authorization request is sent to the State Team.
  • Once they approve the request, you will be able to appear for the Aadhaar Supervisor exam.
  • You can take the Aadhaar LMS Certification once your LMS ID and Password are created and approved. After that, you will be able to appear for the LMS Certification through this link:   https://e-learning.uidai.gov.in

How to Apply for CSC e‑Governance Services Indian Aadhaar Supervisor/Operator Recruitment 2026

Candidates who meet the eligibility criteria can apply online only through the official CSC e‑Governance Services Indian website. Follow the steps given below to submit your application form.

Visit Official Website

  • Go to the official CSC e‑Governance Services Indian website: csc.gov.in.

  • On the homepage, navigate to the Recruitment/Careers/Latest Opening section.

Open Aadhaar Supervisor/Operator Application Link

  • Find and click on the notification/link titled “CSC e‑Governance Services Indian Aadhaar Supervisor/ Operator Recruitment 2026” or similar.

  • Click on the Apply Online button to proceed to the application page.

Registration (New Users)

  • Click on New Registration (if applying for the first time).

  • Enter basic details such as Name, Mobile Number, Email ID, Date of Birth, and create a password.

  • Submit the details to generate your Registration ID and Password (note these for future login).

Login and Fill Application Form

  • Login using your Registration ID and Password.

  • Fill in the online application form carefully with personal details, contact details, educational qualification, Aadhaar Supervisor/Operator certificate details, and preferred state/district.

  • Ensure that all details match your certificates and Aadhaar data.

Upload Documents

  • Upload scanned copies of the following documents in the prescribed format and size (as mentioned in the notification):

    • Recent passport size photograph

    • Signature

    • 10th/12th/ITI/Polytechnic Diploma certificates and mark sheets

    • Aadhaar Operator/Supervisor Certificate issued by UIDAI‑authorized Testing & Certifying Agency

    • Any other documents required as per notification

  • Preview the uploaded documents and confirm that they are clear and readable.

Application Fee Payment (If Applicable)

  • Check the Application Fee section in the official notification.

  • If any fee is prescribed, pay it online through available modes such as Debit Card, Credit Card, Net Banking, or UPI.

  • After successful payment, download/print the fee receipt.

Final Submission

  • Carefully review all the details filled in the application form in the Preview section.

  • If required, make corrections before final submission.

  • Click on Final Submit to complete the application process.

Print Application Form

  • After successful submission, download and take a printout of the final submitted application form for future reference.

  • Keep the Registration ID, Password, and printout safe for further recruitment stages.
