Selection Process

Shortlisting of candidates will be based on the criteria set by the University.

The candidates who have submitted applications by hand or by post and found eligible after scrutiny will be informed through University website for Interview.

The date/schedule of interview will be conveyed later to the candidates who are found eligible for the Post of Trainers (Yoga) by email or through university website. Any further changes in the schedule will be notified through university website i.e. www.graupunjab.org.

The Candidates must have to bring hard copy of filled application form and all original educational qualifications and Experience document (along with a set of self-attested photocopies) before the Selection Committee on the Date of Interview.

Appointment against these posts shall be purely temporary and governed by the term and conditions set by the University. It shall not form any basis for the regular appointment in this University.

The appointment will be made for an initial period of one year extendable further, subject to half-yearly performance report.

The appointments can be terminated at any time by either of the parties at a notice of one week to the other party.

The competent authority reserves all the right to cancel the interview and not to fill all or any post.

How to Apply

Applications on the prescribed proforma to be submitted along with all the relevant documents either by hand or by post to Registrar, Guru Ravidas Ayurved University Punjab, VPO Kharkan, Una Road, Hoshiarpur, Pin Code-146110.

The application form must reach on or before 30.04.2026 (upto 05:00 PM), either by hand or by post.

All columns must be filled in the application form. No column should be left blank, instead it should be marked “N.A.” wherever not applicable.

Applications received after the due date will not be entertained. Also, applications received through email will not be entertained.

The University shall not be responsible for any postal delay.

All the desirous candidates should bring with them the original duly filled Application Proforma available on the website of the University i.e. www.graupunjab.org.

No documents will be accepted or considered by the University after submission of copy of application form by the candidate and no subsequent request for its change will be considered or granted.

General Instructions

  • The candidate must be a citizen of India.
  • A candidate who has passed Senior Secondary/10+2 Examination from Govt. recognized education board and has obtained Diploma in Yoga Sciences or equivalent or Higher Qualification is eligible to apply for the post of Trainer(Yoga).
  • The appointment will be made for an initial period of one year extendable further, subject to half-yearly performance report.
  • All columns must be filled in the application form. No column should be left blank, instead it should be marked “N.A.” wherever not applicable.
  • The application form must reach on or before 30.04.2026 (upto 05:00 PM), either by hand or by post to Registrar, Guru Ravidas Ayurved University Punjab, VPO Kharkan, Una Road, Hoshiarpur, Pin Code-146110 as mentioned in the advertisement. The University shall not be responsible for any postal delay. Applications received after the due date will not be entertained. Also, applications received through email will not be entertained.
  • The candidates who have submitted applications by hand or by post and found eligible after scrutiny will be informed through University website for Interview.
  • The Candidates must have to bring hard copy of filled application form and all original educational qualifications and Experience document (along with a set of self-attested photocopies) before the Selection Committee on the Date of Interview.
  • The candidates are advised to visit University Website i.e. www.graupunjab.org regularly for further updates.
  • The short listing of the candidates will be based on the criteria set by the University.
  • The appointments can be terminated at any time by either of the parties at a notice of one week to the other party.
  • The date/schedule of interview will be conveyed later to the candidates who are found eligible for the Post of Trainers (Yoga) by email or through university website. Any further changes in the schedule will be notified through university website i.e. www.graupunjab.org.
  • The University reserves the right to increase or decrease the number of posts or may not fill up any of the posts advertised without assigning any reason, whatsoever.
  • Appointment against these posts shall be purely temporary and governed by the term and conditions set by the University. It shall not form any basis for the regular appointment in this University.
  • The candidates, working in any organization including Private organizations, claiming previous experience of working in Govt. Department/Autonomous Bodies/ Universities under Central /State Government shall have to enclose a certificate from that Government organization stating no Vigilance or Disciplinary case is pending or contemplated against them.
  • The candidates already working on the regular basis in any college, institution or University shall have to apply through proper channel and enclose “No Objection Certificate” from the employer, stating that in case of their selection, they will be allowed to join the said post.
  • The experience of any candidate will be considered only if the experience certificate is enclosed.
  • No TA/DA in connection with the submission of application form or appearing in the examination/interview will be paid to the candidate.
  • No enquiry in person or in writing for recruitment shall be entertained.
  • No documents will be accepted or considered by the University after submission of copy of online application form by the candidate and no subsequent request for its change will be considered or granted.
  • Any dispute with regard to this recruitment will be subject to the Courts/Tribunals having jurisdiction over State of Punjab.
  • Any candidate who is currently pursuing studies shall continue their studies only through distance education mode and shall submit an undertaking stating that their studies will not suffer due to their engagement as a Trainer Yoga. Prior approval for this shall be taken by candidate after selection as Trainer Yoga.
  • If at any stage, it is found that candidate doesn’t fulfill the eligibility criteria, his/her application will be summarily rejected. Therefore, candidates shall ensure at their end that they fulfill the required eligibility criteria as prescribed in the advertisement for the applied post.
  • In case any dispute over interpretation of any rules, regulation etc. the decision of the Registrar, Guru Ravidas Ayurved University - Hoshiarpur, Punjab, shall be final and binding upon the candidates.
  • Any candidate(s) who was / were recruited earlier under the ‘CM DI Yogshala’ project and his / her services were terminated; they are not eligible to apply against this advertisement.
  • All the desirous candidates should bring with them the original duly filled Application Proforma available on the website of the University i.e. www.graupunjab.org.
  • The candidates will have to produce original documents at the time of Interview. No candidate will be entertained without original Certificates/ Documents.
  • One set of self-attested Photocopies of all the relevant Certificates/documents right from the Matriculation Certificate showing Date of Birth.
  • The competent authority reserves all the right to cancel the interview and not to fill all or any post.

Open the official portal

Shortlisting: Based on API (Academic Performance Indicator) scores as per UGC Regulations. For posts with Concerned/Relevant/Allied subjects, top 13 from Concerned Subject group and top 12 from Relevant/Allied group will be called per post.

Selection: Direct recruitment through All India advertisement and selection by duly constituted Selection Committees. The process may include presentation/seminar/interview or a combination thereof.

Interview: Candidates may be interviewed in person or through Video Conferencing. SC/ST/PwD outstation candidates will be reimbursed to-and-fro rail fare (as per GoI Rules) for attending interview.

Step 4 – Upload all required documents including qualification certificates, mark sheets, experience certificate (with Date of Joining, Date of Relieving, designation, pay scale, date of promotion), at least one salary slip per financial year for each claimed experience, Form-16 (for Non-Government organizations), NOC from employer (if currently employed in Government/Semi-Government/PSU/Autonomous body), caste/disability/EWS certificate as applicable, and equivalence certificate for foreign PhD (if applicable).

Step 5 – Preview and verify all details before final submission. Incomplete applications or those without fee and required enclosures will be summarily rejected.

Step 6 – Submit the application before 27 April 2026 (05:00 PM IST). No hard copy of the application form should be sent to the University.

Step 7 – Retain a duly signed printout of the online application form along with all enclosures for future reference.

Selection Process

Selection will be made through Walk-in-Interview only.

  • Candidates must fill the prescribed Application Form (attached with the advertisement) completely.
  • Submit the filled Application Form at the venue of the interview along with:
    • Original documents + one set of self-attested photocopies of all required certificates.
    • Three recent passport size photographs.
  • Interview will be conducted on the spot.
  • Candidates will be shortlisted on the basis of credentials, educational qualification, experience (if any) and performance in the personal interview.
  • Offer of engagement will be issued to the suitable candidates in the order of merit and as per the number of vacancies.
  • In addition to the main panel, a reserved panel will also be prepared which will be used in case of any shortfall.
  • Engagement is subject to being found medically fit as per IRCTC norms.

How to Apply

Application Mode: Walk-in-Interview only (No online application).

Steps to Apply:

  1. Download and fill the prescribed Application Form (attached with the notification) in all respects.
  2. Bring the filled Application Form along with:
    • Original + one set of self-attested copies of all educational certificates, experience certificates (if any), category certificate, Aadhaar, etc.
    • Three recent passport size photographs.
  3. Appear personally at the venue on the scheduled date and time for document verification and interview.
  4. No TA/DA will be paid for attending the walk-in-interview.

Note: In case of extension of interview dates, candidates will have to arrange their own stay and food.

General Instructions

  • Engagement is purely contractual for an initial period of 02 years and extendable by one more year based on requirement and satisfactory performance. It will not confer any right for regular/permanent employment in IRCTC.
  • Contract can be terminated by giving one month’s notice by either side.
  • Selected candidates will have to furnish a Security Deposit of ₹25,000/- (DD/NEFT).
  • Only Indian Nationals are eligible to apply.
  • Candidates working in Govt./PSUs must produce No Objection Certificate (NOC) at the time of interview and proper relieving letter at the time of joining.
  • Candidates should ensure that they fulfil all eligibility criteria. If any false information is found at any stage, candidature/services will be terminated.
  • IRCTC reserves the right to cancel/amend the advertisement or the selection process at any stage.
  • Number of vacancies may increase or decrease as per requirement.
  • Knowledge of computer (MS Office) and preparation of reports is essential.
  • Good communication skills in English & Hindi are mandatory; knowledge of local languages (Tamil, Kannada, Malayalam) is an added advantage.
  • The selected candidate may be posted in Tamil Nadu, Kerala & Karnataka and can be deployed anywhere in India as per requirement.
  • All corrigendum/clarifications will be uploaded only on IRCTC website www.irctc.com. Candidates are advised to visit the website regularly.
  • Canvassing in any form will disqualify the candidature.

How to Apply

Candidates must register as per 'ONE TIME REGISTRATION ' with the Official Website of Kerala Public Service Commission 'www.keralapsc.gov.in' before applying for the post. Candidates who have registered can apply by logging on to their profile using their User-ID and password. Candidates must click on the 'Apply Now' button of the respective posts in the Notification Link to apply for a post.

Candidates who create new Profile should upload their Photograph taken within a period of 6 months. Name of the candidate and the date of photograph taken should be printed legibly at the bottom portion. The photograph once uploaded meeting all requirements shall be valid for 10 years from the date of uploading. .

There is no change in other instructions regarding the uploading of photographs. No application fee is required. Candidates are responsible for the correctness of the personal information and secrecy of password. Before the final submission of the application on the profile candidates must ensure correctness of the information in their profile. They must quote the User-ID for further communication with the Commission. Application submitted is provisional and cannot be deleted or altered after submission. Candidates are advised to keep a printout or soft copy of the online application for future reference.

Candidates can take the printout of the application by clicking on the link 'My applications' in their profile. All correspondences with the Commission, regarding the application should be accompanied with the printout of the application. The application will be summarily rejected if noncompliance with the notification is found in due course of processing. Documents to prove qualification, age, Community etc. have to be produced as and when called for.

Candidates who have AADHAAR card should add AADHAAR Card as ID Proof in their profile.

  • The selection process will be conducted as per the rules and regulations of Travancore Titanium Products Ltd.

  • The Ranked List will remain in force for a minimum period of one year and a maximum period of three years.
  • Kerala PSC reserves the right to cancel the advice for appointment of any candidate if any mistake is found later.
  • Final selection is subject to verification of original documents and medical fitness.

General Information/Instructions

  • Aadhaar Card must be added as ID proof in the profile.
  • Candidates must read and follow the General Conditions given in Part II of the Gazette Notification.

  • The selection is subject to the rules and regulations of Travancore Titanium Products Ltd.
  • Any false information or suppression of facts will lead to rejection of candidature at any stage.

Selection Process

  • The selection process for Central Bank of India Specialist Officers in Risk Management streams consists of an online written examination followed by a personal interview.

  • The final merit will be prepared by giving 70% weightage to the online written test and 30% weightage to the interview, subject to document verification and medical fitness.

  • Only those candidates who qualify the online exam and meet the bank’s cutoff will be called for the interview in a prescribed ratio to the number of vacancies.

How to Apply

Visit official website

  • Go to the official Central Bank of India website: centralbank.bank.in.

  • Open the “Recruitment/ Careers” section and click on the link for “Recruitment Process for Selection of Officers in Specialist Category in Risk Management Streams.”

Open Apply Online link

  • On the recruitment page, click on “Click Here to Apply” / “Apply Online” which redirects to the online registration page (IBPS application link for CBI SO).

  • Read the detailed notification, “How to Apply” and FAQ on the registration page carefully before proceeding.

New registration

  • Click on “New Registration” and enter basic details (name, contact number, email ID, etc.) to generate a Registration Number and Password.

  • Note down the Registration Number and Password for future login and form completion.

Fill online application form

  • Log in using Registration Number and Password and select the relevant post/scale (Analytics & Model Risk, Asset Liability Management, Digital Risk Management, Enterprise Risk, Market Risk in Scale IV/III/II as applicable).

  • Fill personal details, category, domicile, address, qualification (B.Sc/B.Tech/BE/MBA/PGDM etc.) and post-qualification experience in Risk/IT/ALM/Digital Risk as per eligibility.

  • Ensure all experience details (years, organisation, role) match what is required for the chosen scale and stream.

Upload required documents

  • Upload recent passport-size photograph, signature, left thumb impression and handwritten declaration in the prescribed dimensions and file size, as per the instructions in the notification.

  • Upload supporting documents (if asked at application stage) like educational certificates, experience certificates and category certificates in the specified format.

Pay application fee

  • Pay the application fee online: ₹175/- (intimation charges) for SC/ST/PwBD/Women candidates and ₹850/- (application fee + intimation charges) for all other candidates, through debit card/credit card/net banking/UPI.

  • After successful payment, verify that the fee status shows as “paid” and proceed to final submit. Applications without successful fee payment (where applicable) will be treated as incomplete.

Final submission and print

  • Review all details carefully; edit if required before final submission, as no changes are allowed after final submit.

  • Click on “Final Submit” and generate your application form.

  • Download and take a printout of the e-receipt and submitted application form for future reference, online exam and interview/document verification stages.

General Instructions for Candidates

  • Apply online only; no other mode of application will be accepted.

  • Ensure you fall within the required age limits for Scale IV (20–45 years) and Scale III/II (20–35 years) with applicable relaxations as per Government/Bank rules.

  • Enter details exactly as per your certificates; any mismatch or false information may lead to rejection at any stage of the recruitment process.

  • Keep the registered mobile number and email ID active; all communication regarding exam date, admit card, interview schedule, etc., will be sent on these only.

  • Candidates are advised to complete the application process well before 30-04-2026 to avoid last-minute technical issues.

Indian Navy Agniveer (MR/Musician) Recruitment 2026 Eligibility Criteria

Educational Qualification: Candidate must have passed Matriculation Examination with minimum 50% marks in aggregate from the Boards of School Education recognised by Ministry of Education, Govt. of India.

Age Limit: Born between 01 Jul 2004 – 31 Dec 2008 (both dates inclusive).

Marital Status: Only unmarried male and unmarried female candidates are eligible. Candidates will have to give a certificate of being 'unmarried' at the time of enrolment. Agniveers shall not be permitted to marry during their entire tenure of four years. Marriage during tenure will result in dismissal.

Musical Ability: The candidate should have proficiency and aptitude for music with accuracy in tempo, pitch and singing one complete song. He/She should also have actual practical skill on any instrument of Indian or foreign origin with proficiency in tuning of instrument, matching unknown notes with instrument, prepared piece, sight reading of Indian Classical/Tablature/Staff Notation, performance of Scale/Raaga/Taala and basic theory of Indian or International music.

Type of Instruments on which Proficiency Required: Candidates would be required to perform with expertise on one or more instruments such as Keyboard/String/Wind instruments or any other instrument of Indian or foreign origin. Candidates performing on indefinite pitch instruments such as Jazz Drum set, Bass Drum, Snare Drums, Side Drums, Cymbals, Non Chromatic instruments such as bugle & monotone instruments used to produce only one note or drone will not be eligible.

Musical Experience Certificate:

  • Candidates performing Hindustani or Carnatic Classical music on wind instruments will require a musical experience certificate from any recognized musical institute or organisation of repute.
  • A certificate of minimum initial grade from international boards such as Trinity College of Music, London or Royal School of Music London etc., will be mandatory for candidates performing western notation or western music on wind instruments.
  • Other candidates will be required to submit certificates of participation/awards presented at various events.

Physical Standards:

  • Minimum Height: 157 cm (Male & Female)
  • Visual Standards: 6/12, 6/12 (Uncorrected) | 6/6, 6/6 (Corrected) | CP Pass

Indian Navy Agniveer (MR/Musician) Recruitment 2026 Selection Process

Selection of recruits is based on the order of merit based on their performance in Music Ability Test.

  1. Shortlisting: Based on marks obtained in Matriculation examination (All India merit). Only candidates holding valid music certificates will be considered.
  2. Recruitment Process: Physical Fitness Test (PFT) → Written Examination → Music Ability Test → Recruitment Medical Examination.

UPSSSC Forest Guard Selection Process 2026

The selection process for UPSSSC Forest Guard and Wildlife Guard Recruitment 2026 is based on a two-tier examination system. In the first stage, candidates will be shortlisted for the Main Written Examination on the basis of their PET-2025 Normalised Score.

Thereafter, candidates who qualify the written examination will be called for Physical Standard Test, Physical Efficiency Test, and Medical Examination — all of which are qualifying in nature. Stage Details

3. Physical Standard Test (PST) Measurement of height and chest as per prescribed standards; qualifying in nature
4. Physical Efficiency Test (PET) Male candidates: 25 km walk/run carrying 10 kg weight in 4 hours; Female candidates: 14 km walk/run in 4 hours; qualifying in nature
5. Medical Examination Conducted by a Medical Board constituted by the Chief Medical Officer at District Community Health Centres; qualifying in nature
6. Document Verification Verification of all original certificates and documents

Selection Process

Selection will be made through Personal Interview only.

  • SIDBI will conduct a preliminary screening of all applications received and prepare a shortlist of eligible candidates.
  • Shortlisted candidates will be called for Personal Interview at New Delhi before a Selection Committee.
  • Interviews may also be conducted through Web meetings (MS Teams).
  • Candidates shortlisted for interview shall have to mandatorily produce all original certificates/documents for verification at the time of interview (or as decided by SIDBI).
  • Mere fulfillment of eligibility criteria does not entitle any candidate to be called for interview.
  • Final selection is based on performance in the Personal Interview and overall suitability.

How to Apply

Application Mode: Only through Email (No hard copy required)

Steps to Apply:

  1. Fill the prescribed Application Form (Appendix-II given in the notification) in BLOCK LETTERS.
  2. Tick only one position you are applying for (you can apply for only one post).
  3. Attach self-attested scanned copies of all required documents (file type: .jpg/.png/.pdf).
  4. Sign the application form.
  5. Send the complete application by email with the subject line: “Application for the post of [Post Name]” (Advertisement No.: GCFV/30032026/OUT/72754 dated April 01, 2026)

  • [email protected]
  • [email protected]

  • CV

IGM Noida Recruitment 2026 Eligibility Criteria

  • Supervisor (Assay/T.O.-Mechanical/Electrical/Metallurgy): Candidates must possess a 1st class full-time Diploma in Engineering in the relevant stream (Chemical/Mechanical/Electrical/Metallurgy) from a recognized institution, or higher qualification i.e. B.Tech/B.E./B.Sc. (Engineering) in the relevant discipline.
  • Engraver (Sculpture/Metal Works): Candidates must hold a Bachelor of Fine Arts (Sculpture or Metal Works) with at least 55% marks from a recognized institution.
  • Jr. Office Assistant & Jr. Bullion Assistant: Candidates must be a Graduate in any discipline with computer knowledge and typing speed of English @ 40 w.p.m. / Hindi @ 30 w.p.m.
  • Jr. Hindi Typist: Candidates must be a Graduate in any discipline with computer knowledge and Hindi typing speed @ 30 w.p.m.
  • Laboratory Assistant: Candidates must hold a B.Sc. with Chemistry as a major subject with at least 55% marks.
  • Jr. Technician (all trades): Candidates must hold a full-time ITI certificate recognized by NCVT/SCVT in the relevant trade (Fitter/Turner/Electrician/Carpentry/Melter/Chemical Plant Operator/Goldsmith).
  • Age Limit: Minimum 18 years; maximum 25 years for Jr. Technician posts, 28 years for B-3/B-4 level posts, and 30 years for Supervisor posts, as on the closing date of online application. Age relaxation is provided for SC/ST (5 years), OBC-NCL (3 years), PwBD (10–15 years), and Ex-Servicemen as per Government of India rules.

IGM Noida Recruitment 2026 Salary

  • Selected candidates under IGM Noida Recruitment 2026 will be appointed on regular posts with pay scales as per the company's pay structure along with applicable allowances.
  • Pay Scale Details: Supervisor posts carry Level S-1 pay matrix ₹27,600–95,910; Engraver and Jr. Office/Bullion Assistant/Lab Assistant posts carry Level B-3 ₹21,540–77,160 or Level B-4 ₹23,910–85,570; and Junior Technician posts carry Level W-1 ₹18,780–67,390. Selected candidates will be placed on probation for one year, extendable by a further one year at the discretion of the company.

IGM Noida Recruitment 2026 Application Fees

  • As per the IGM Recruitment 2026 advertisement, candidates belonging to UR, EWS and OBC categories must pay a non-refundable fee of ₹1000/- (inclusive of GST).
  • SC/ST and PwBD candidates are exempted from payment of the application fee but are required to pay a non-refundable fee of ₹200/- towards service expenses.
  • Payment can be made online through Debit Cards, Credit Cards, Internet Banking, or UPI. Fee once paid is non-refundable under any circumstances.

IGM Noida Recruitment 2026 Selection Process

  • The IGM Noida Recruitment 2026 selection process will be conducted through an online Computer Based Test (CBT) of objective type, followed by a Typing/Skill Test for certain posts, and a final merit list based on CBT performance.
  • For Supervisor posts (S-1 Level): A single-phase CBT of 150 marks in 120 minutes consisting of General Arithmetic (25 marks), Logical Reasoning (20 marks), and Technical/Professional knowledge in the relevant trade (105 marks).
  • For Jr. Office Assistant, Jr. Bullion Assistant & Jr. Hindi Typist (B-3 Level): A CBT of 150 marks in 120 minutes comprising General Awareness (30), Computer Knowledge (30), English Language Skills (30), Numerical Aptitude (30), and Reasoning Aptitude (30), followed by a Typing Test (English @ 40 w.p.m. or Hindi @ 30 w.p.m.). Final merit is based on CBT performance only.
  • For Jr. Technician posts (W-1 Level): A single-phase CBT of 120 marks in 120 minutes comprising General Arithmetic (20 marks), Logical Reasoning (15 marks), and Technical/Professional knowledge in the relevant trade (85 marks).
  • Minimum Qualifying Marks: General/EWS category – 55%; OBC – 50%; SC/ST – 45%. There is no negative marking.

The online application process for India Government Mint IGM Recruitment 2026 will start from 28th March 2026 and the last date to submit the IGM online application form is 27th April 2026. Candidates must visit the official website igmnoida.spmcil.com, open the career page and complete their IGM Recruitment 2026 Application Form within the given dates.

While filling the India Government Mint application form 2026, candidates should register with a valid email ID and mobile number, enter personal and educational details, upload scanned documents, pay the examination fee (if applicable) and finally submit and download the IGM online form for future reference.

Candidates who wish to apply for the India Government Mint IGM Recruitment 2026 must submit their application forms through the online mode only within the specified dates. Follow the step-by-step process given below to fill the IGM online application form correctly.

  • Eligible candidates for IGM Noida Recruitment 2026 must complete the online application through the company's official website within the specified dates.
  • Step 1 – Visit Official Website: Go to http://igmnoida.spmcil.com, click on "Discover SPMCIL" and navigate to the CAREERS page to find the IGM Recruitment 2026 link.
  • Step 2 – Registration: Register on the portal using a valid mobile number and email ID, create login credentials, and proceed to the IGM online application form 2026.
  • Step 3 – Fill Application Form: Enter personal details, address, educational qualifications, category, unit preference (Mumbai/Kolkata/Hyderabad/Noida), and post applied for carefully, ensuring all data matches your original certificates.

  • Step 5 – Pay Fee & Submit: Complete the online fee payment (where applicable) through Debit/Credit Card, Internet Banking, or UPI. Selection Process

  • Stage 1 – Written Examination (Main Exam):
    • One question paper containing 100 objective-type, multiple-choice questions.
    • Total duration: 120 Minutes (Two Hours).
    • Each question carries 1 mark. Negative marking: 25% (i.e., ¼ of the mark prescribed for each wrong answer).
    • Exam Plan:
      • Part-1: Introduction to Disability (25 Marks) + Child Development & Learning (20 Marks) + Rights of Persons with Disabilities Act, 2016 (20 Marks)
      • Part-2: Knowledge of Concepts of Computer and IT and Contemporary Technological Development (15 Marks)
      • Part-3: General Information related to the State of Uttar Pradesh (20 Marks)
      • Total: 100 Questions – 100 Marks
    • Shortlisting for Written Exam will be based on normalized score of PET-2025 (15 times the number of advertised posts).
  • Stage 2 – Qualifying Exam (Skill Test):
    • Candidates shortlisted on the basis of written exam marks will appear for Sign Language and Braille Script Proficiency Test (qualifying in nature).
    • For posts where Sign Language/Braille Script knowledge is not required in eligibility criteria, selection will be based on written exam only.
    • Sign Language Proficiency Test:
      • Component 1: Text to Sign Language Conversion – More than 20 functional words; 8 minutes; qualifying: minimum 10 functional words correctly converted.
      • Component 2: Sign Language to Text Conversion – More than 20 functional words; 8 minutes; qualifying: minimum 10 functional words correctly converted.
    • Braille Script Proficiency Test:
      • Component 1: Text to Braille Script Writing – 150–200 Hindi words; 10 minutes; qualifying: minimum 60 words accurately written in Braille.
      • Component 2: Braille Script to Text Writing – 80–100 Hindi words; 10 minutes; qualifying: minimum 40 words read and written accurately.

  • Application must be submitted ONLY through the Online Application System on the Commission's website upsssc.gov.in. Applications submitted through any other means will not be accepted.

  • Candidates must login using their PET-2025 Registration Number along with the OTP sent to their registered mobile number/email.
  • After login, personal details pre-filled from PET-2025 registration will be displayed. Candidates must verify and select the posts they wish to apply for.
  • Select the post(s), fill in qualification details (Board/University name, pass year, certificate/roll number, issue date, marks details), and proceed.
  • Photo and signature uploaded during PET-2025 will be auto-displayed. No changes can be made to these.
  • Fill in post preference and additional qualification details in the "Other Details" section.
  • Enter the Verification Code displayed on the Registration Page and click the "Submit" button.
  • Pay the prescribed fee using Credit Card / Debit Card / Internet Banking / UPI / SBI e-Challan before the last date (27-04-2026).
  • After successful fee payment/reconciliation, the application form will be auto-submitted and displayed on screen. Candidates must download and print the application form.
  • Application correction is permitted up to 04-05-2026 for fields like correspondence address, EWS/OBC category, gender, disability category, and marital status.
  • Only one application per candidate. If multiple applications are submitted, only the last submitted application will be considered valid.

UPSSSC AGTA Selection Process 2026

The UPSSSC Agriculture Technical Assistant (AGTA) / Technical Assistant Group C Recruitment 2026 selection process comprises shortlisting on the basis of UPSSSC PET 2025 scores, a mains written examination and document verification. Only PET 2025 qualified candidates will be allowed to appear in the UPSSSC AGTA mains exam.

Stage 1 – Shortlisting through UPSSSC PET 2025

  • Candidates must have a valid UPSSSC PET 2025 scorecard to apply for the UPSSSC Technical Assistant Group C mains examination.
  • UPSSSC will prepare a list of eligible candidates for AGTA mains based on PET 2025 scores, reservation rules and post‑wise vacancy distribution.
  • Only shortlisted candidates, as per the criteria given in the official notification, will be permitted to fill the UPSSSC AGTA mains online form and appear for the written exam.

Stage 2 – UPSSSC AGTA Mains Written Examination 2026

  • The mains written exam for UPSSSC Agriculture Technical Assistant Group C will be an objective type paper covering agriculture and related subjects as per the prescribed syllabus.
  • The question paper will carry a fixed number of questions and marks (details like total marks, duration and negative marking will be as per the official AGTA notification).
  • Candidates must secure the minimum qualifying marks and rank high in the merit list to be considered for the next stage of the selection process.

Stage 3 – Document Verification

  • Candidates shortlisted on the basis of performance in the AGTA mains written exam will be called for document verification (DV).
  • During DV, candidates must produce original documents and certificates related to age, educational qualification, category (SC/ST/OBC/EWS), domicile, PET 2025 score, and other eligibility criteria.
  • Failure to produce valid documents or any discrepancy in information can lead to cancellation of candidature for UPSSSC Technical Assistant Group C Recruitment 2026.

The final selection list for UPSSSC AGTA Recruitment 2026 will be prepared purely on the basis of marks obtained in the mains written examination, subject to successful document verification and fulfilment of all eligibility conditions.

How to Apply for UPSSSC AGTA / Technical Assistant Group C Recruitment 2026

The application process for UPSSSC Agriculture Technical Assistant (AGTA) / Technical Assistant Group C Recruitment 2026 is completely online. Only candidates who have a valid UPSSSC PET 2025 registration and score can fill the UPSSSC AGTA online form 2026 on the official website upsssc.gov.in.

  • Step 1: Visit the official website of Uttar Pradesh Subordinate Services Selection Commission at upsssc.gov.in.
  • Step 2: On the home page, click on the “Notifications/Advertisements” section and open the link for Advt. No. 06-Exam/2026 – Technical Assistant Group C (AGTA) Recruitment 2026.
  • Step 3: Read the UPSSSC AGTA Notification 2026 carefully, then click on the “Apply” or “Candidate Registration” link given against the advertisement.
  • Step 4: Log in using your UPSSSC PET 2025 Registration Number, date of birth and other required details; the system will fetch your basic data from the PET database.
  • Step 5: Fill the UPSSSC AGTA online application form 2026 with category, educational qualification, agriculture degree details, reservation information and other required fields.
  • Step 6: Upload your recent passport size photograph and signature in the prescribed format and size as mentioned in the UPSSSC Technical Assistant Group C notification.
  • Step 7: Pay the UPSSSC AGTA application fee of ₹25 (for all categories) using the available online payment options such as net banking, debit/credit card, SBI I‑Collect or e‑challan.
  • Step 8: Review all the details entered in the UPSSSC Technical Assistant Group C application form carefully, then submit the form and take a printout of the final submitted application and fee receipt for future reference.

Candidates should complete the UPSSSC AGTA Online Form 2026 well before the last date to avoid last minute technical issues and ensure successful submission.

UPSSSC Combined Lower Subordinate Services Recruitment 2026 Selection Process

The UPSSSC Combined Lower Subordinate Services (Graduate Level) Recruitment 2026 selection will be based on a Written Main Examination (Likhit Pariksha).

Main Examination (Written Test – 100 Marks, 2 Hours): There will be one question paper containing 100 objective-type multiple-choice questions carrying 100 marks with a duration of 2 hours (120 minutes). There is negative marking of 1/4 (25%) of prescribed marks for each wrong answer.

The examination paper will be divided into three parts as follows:

  Geography of India & World 05 05

Shortlisting for Main Exam: Candidates will be shortlisted for the Main Examination based on their normalised score in PET-2025, taking 15 times the category-wise vacancies (up to the final cut-off score, rounded to 2 decimal places).

Eligible candidates for UPSSSC Combined Lower Subordinate Services Recruitment 2026 must apply online through the official UPSSSC portal before the last date.

Step 1 – Login via PET-2025 Registration Number: Visit upsssc.gov.in and login using your PET-2025 Registration Number and OTP sent to the registered mobile number/email. Only PET-2025 registered candidates can apply.

Step 2 – Select Posts and Fill Application: Your personal details from PET-2025 will be auto-displayed. Select the post(s) you wish to apply for, verify eligibility, and fill in all educational qualification, community, and other details carefully.

Step 3 – Enter Post Preference: In the "Other Details" section, enter your post and department preference priority and indicate preferential/additional qualification details (if applicable).

Step 4 – Verify Photo and Signature: Your photo and signature uploaded in PET-2025 will be auto-displayed. No changes can be made. Click Continue to proceed.

Step 5 – Pay Application Fee: Pay Rs.25/- via Credit Card, Debit Card, Internet Banking, UPI, or SBI e-Challan. After successful payment, your application form will be auto-submitted. Download and print the application form immediately.

Step 6 – Fee Reconciliation & Amendment: If required, reconcile fee and amend permissible details (correspondence address, EWS/horizontal reservation category, educational qualification, marital status) on the Applicant's Dashboard by 25 June 2026. Save a printout of the final application for future reference.

How to Apply for CSC e‑Governance Services Indian Aadhaar Supervisor/Operator Recruitment 2026

Candidates who meet the eligibility criteria can apply online only through the official CSC e‑Governance Services Indian website. Follow the steps given below to submit your application form.

Visit Official Website

  • Go to the official CSC e‑Governance Services Indian website: csc.gov.in.

  • On the homepage, navigate to the Recruitment/Careers/Latest Opening section.

Open Aadhaar Supervisor/Operator Application Link

  • Find and click on the notification/link titled “CSC e‑Governance Services Indian Aadhaar Supervisor/ Operator Recruitment 2026” or similar.

  • Click on the Apply Online button to proceed to the application page.

Registration (New Users)

  • Click on New Registration (if applying for the first time).

  • Enter basic details such as Name, Mobile Number, Email ID, Date of Birth, and create a password.

  • Submit the details to generate your Registration ID and Password (note these for future login).

Login and Fill Application Form

  • Login using your Registration ID and Password.

  • Fill in the online application form carefully with personal details, contact details, educational qualification, Aadhaar Supervisor/Operator certificate details, and preferred state/district.

  • Ensure that all details match your certificates and Aadhaar data.

Upload Documents

  • Upload scanned copies of the following documents in the prescribed format and size (as mentioned in the notification):

    • Recent passport size photograph

    • Signature

    • 10th/12th/ITI/Polytechnic Diploma certificates and mark sheets

    • Aadhaar Operator/Supervisor Certificate issued by UIDAI‑authorized Testing & Certifying Agency

    • Any other documents required as per notification

  • Preview the uploaded documents and confirm that they are clear and readable.

Application Fee Payment (If Applicable)

  • Check the Application Fee section in the official notification.

  • If any fee is prescribed, pay it online through available modes such as Debit Card, Credit Card, Net Banking, or UPI.

  • After successful payment, download/print the fee receipt.

Final Submission

  • Carefully review all the details filled in the application form in the Preview section.

  • If required, make corrections before final submission.

  • Click on Final Submit to complete the application process.

Print Application Form

  • After successful submission, download and take a printout of the final submitted application form for future reference.

  • Keep the Registration ID, Password, and printout safe for further recruitment stages.

Selection will be made through Walk-in-Interview only.

STPI Apprentice Trainee Stipend 2026

Selected Apprentice Trainees will receive a monthly stipend as per the qualification category. B.Tech/B.E. degree holders will receive Rs. 15,000/- per month, Diploma holders will receive Rs. 10,900/- per month, and B.A./B.Com degree holders will receive Rs. 12,300/- per month.

The stipend will be facilitated through the Direct Benefit Transfer (DBT) mechanism - the Government's admissible share of the stipend will be directly credited to the apprentice's bank account through the NATS portal after successful DBT registration.

Candidates must ensure their bank account details (account number, IFSC code, bank name) are accurately entered during NATS portal registration, as any error may delay or prevent stipend disbursement. This is a training stipend and not a salary - no other allowances or service benefits are associated with the apprenticeship engagement.

Stage 2: Online Application on STPI Portal Apply online on www.stpi.in (Career Section) on or before 11/05/2026. Enter the NATS Enrolment ID in the application form.
Stage 3: Shortlisting Applications screened based on eligibility criteria - qualification, discipline, age, and NATS registration.
Stage 4: Interview Shortlisted candidates called for interview. Final selection based on marks obtained in the interview.

How to Apply for STPI Apprentice Trainee Recruitment 2026

The application process is entirely online - only online applications through STPI's web portal will be accepted; no offline, postal, or email applications will be considered. Before applying on the STPI portal, candidates must mandatorily register on the NATS Portal (https://nats.education.gov.in) and obtain their unique NATS Enrolment ID, which is required to be entered in the STPI online application form.

Keep all educational certificates, identity documents, and bank account details ready before starting the NATS registration. After successful NATS registration, visit STPI's official website www.stpi.in, go to the Career Section, and complete the online application before 11/05/2026. Candidates are advised to apply well in advance and not wait until the last date to avoid technical difficulties.

  • Step 1: Register on the NATS Portal at https://nats.education.gov.in and obtain your unique NATS Enrolment ID (refer to Annexure A in the notification for step-by-step instructions).
  • Step 2: Visit STPI's official website www.stpi.in → Career Section.
  • Step 3: Fill in the online application form with all required details including the NATS Enrolment ID.
  • Step 4: Upload required documents as specified in the application form.
  • Step 5: Submit the online application on or before 11/05/2026.
  • Step 6: Take a printout of the submitted application form for future reference.

NATS Portal Registration Guide for STPI Apprentice Trainee 2026

Registration on the NATS Portal (National Apprenticeship Training Scheme - https://nats.education.gov.in) is mandatory for all candidates before applying on the STPI portal. The NATS Enrolment ID generated after registration must be entered in the STPI online application - applications without this ID will not be accepted.

The stipend will also be processed through NATS via DBT, so accurate bank account details must be provided during registration. A step-by-step guide (Annexure A) is included in the official notification. The key steps are summarised below for quick reference.

Step Action Details
Step 1 Visit NATS Portal Go to https://nats.education.gov.in → Click on "Student" in the top menu bar
Step 2 Enrol as a Student Click "Enroll" under Student section → Read eligibility criteria → Click "Yes" if eligible → Proceed to Enrollment Form
Step 3 Fill Personal Information Enter name, date of birth, gender, email, mobile number → Create login ID and password → Enter Aadhaar number and other identification details
Step 4 Fill Educational Details Select highest qualification (Diploma / Graduate) → Enter institution name, year of passing, percentage/CGPA
Step 5 Fill Communication & Bank Details Enter present and permanent address → Enter bank account number, IFSC code, and bank name (for DBT stipend processing)
Step 6 Review and Submit Review all details carefully → Submit the registration form → Unique NATS Enrolment ID generated and sent to registered email ID

Important Instructions for Candidates

  • Only online applications through www.stpi.in (Career Section) will be accepted.
  • NATS Portal registration at https://nats.education.gov.in is mandatory before applying on STPI portal.
  • Qualification must have been completed in April 2021 or thereafter.
  • Candidates who have already completed apprenticeship anywhere are not eligible.
  • Reservation as per Govt. of India rules: preference to 3-OBC, 2-SC, 1-ST out of 15 posts.
  • Stipend paid through DBT via NATS portal - ensure bank details are correctly entered during NATS registration.
  • Applications received after 11/05/2026 will not be considered under any circumstances.

The selection for Karnataka Civil Judge Recruitment 2026 will be based on the following:

Main Written Examination: Translation Paper (100 marks), Law Paper-I (100 marks), Law Paper-II (100 marks), Law Paper-III (100 marks). Minimum qualifying marks per paper: 40 (SC/ST/PwBD) / 50 (others).

Viva-voce: 100 marks. Minimum qualifying marks: 20% (SC/ST/PwBD) / 25% (others).

Computer Test: 25 marks (qualifying nature; not added to total).

Final selection is based on aggregate marks obtained in the Competitive Examination (Written Examination + Viva-voce). Candidates must also pass the Kannada Language Examination conducted by KPSC.

Final Selection: Final selection will be based on performance in the personal interview. A waiting list will be prepared and will be valid for a period of 2 months from the date of release of result. Final result will be published on the website at https://www.esic.gov.in/recruitments.

Type Requirement

Preferred At least 3 years of experience within the Banking, Financial Services, and Insurance (BFSI) sector.
Technical Exposure Proven expertise in managing large-scale technical programs with multiple streams of deliverables.
Specific Skills Experience in Core Banking transformation, Payments (UPI/Swift), Compliance, Reg Tech, Retail Lending, Digital Lending, Corporate Lending, Customer Lifecycle projects, General ERP/CRM/Web-App development.

SBI SCO Lead Business Analyst 2026 - Job Profile & Key Responsibilities

  • Mentor and supervise the Business Analyst team involved in several stages of SDLC.
  • Oversee stakeholder interactions and the complete requirement lifecycle to ensure accurate capture of business intent, regulatory needs, and technical feasibility.
  • Validate solution designs/documents for scalability, security, and integration — promoting a "product-first" mindset aligned with enterprise architecture.
  • Lead process analysis across banking domains (Payments, Lending) to ensure As-Is/To-Be models and gap analyses are data-driven and implementation-ready.
  • Enforce documentation standards to meet audit and regulatory compliance.
  • Consolidate team insights to provide strategic advisory to senior management on domain-technology convergence, product enhancements, and market benchmarking.
  • Drive adherence to defined Turnaround Time (TAT) for all deliverables and monitor performance against regulatory timelines.

SBI SCO Lead Business Analyst 2026 - Remuneration & Contract Terms

₹ 45 Lakhs per annum (CTC Upper Range)

Annual CTC is negotiable and will depend upon experience & current emoluments. Contract period: 5 Years.

SBI SCO Recruitment 2026 - Selection Process

  • Shortlisting: Merely fulfilling the minimum qualification and experience does not guarantee a call for interview. The shortlisting committee constituted by the Bank will decide the shortlisting parameters. The Bank's decision to call candidates for interaction shall be final.
  • Interview: Interview will carry 100 marks. Qualifying marks will be decided by the Bank. Merit list will be prepared in descending order of scores obtained in interview only.
  • Tie-breaking: In case of equal marks at cut-off, candidates will be ranked according to their age in descending order.
  • Call Letter: Intimation/call letter for interview will be uploaded on the Bank's website or sent by email. No hard copy will be sent.
  • Travel Reimbursement: Outstation candidates shortlisted for interview will be reimbursed Air fare (Economy Class) for the shortest route, maximum up to Rs. 15,000/- (both ways) or actual travel cost, whichever is lower. Local conveyance will not be reimbursable.

2. Fill Application Form: Fill in all details carefully. The application can be saved if unable to complete in one go — a provisional registration number and password will be generated. 3. Upload Documents: Upload all required documents in the prescribed format. All documents (except photo & signature) must be in PDF format, A4 size, max 500 kb. Photo: JPG/JPEG, 20-50 kb, 200×230 pixels. Signature: JPG/JPEG, 10-20 kb, 140×60 pixels (on white paper with black ink pen; signature in CAPITAL LETTERS not accepted).

4. Pay Application Fee: Pay Rs. 750/- (General/EWS/OBC) or Nil (SC/ST/PwBD) online via Debit Card/Credit Card/Internet Banking/UPI. On successful payment, an e-receipt and application form will be generated — print and retain for records. Registration is complete only after successful fee payment.

5. Take Printout: After final submission, take a printout of the system-generated online application form for future reference. All updates will be posted on the Bank's website only — no separate communications will be sent.

Candidates must be Maharashtra domicile holders and must possess knowledge of Marathi - reading, writing, and speaking. Candidates with CGPA/Grade in their final year certificate must get it converted to percentage by the issuing institution and submit the certified conversion along with the application. Experience acquired only after obtaining the required minimum educational qualification will be considered.

MBMC NHM/NTEP/15th FC/HBT Selection Process 2026

The selection process differs based on the nature of the post. For specialist and medical officer posts (Super-Specialist, Specialist, MBBS Medical Officer), selection is through direct interview using a structured scoring system of 50 marks covering subject knowledge (10), research and academic knowledge (10), leadership quality (10), administrative abilities (10), and experience (10 marks - 2 marks/year for government experience and 1 mark/year for private experience).

For all other posts, selection is based on a merit/scoring method without a direct interview, where marks are allotted based on final year percentage of minimum required qualification (50 marks), additional/postgraduate qualification percentage (20 marks), and relevant experience at 6 marks per year up to a maximum of 30 marks - totalling 100 marks.

After the merit list is prepared, candidates equal to 150% (1.5 times) of the number of vacancies will be called for original document verification. Candidates absent on the document verification day will be disqualified.

Online Examination (300 marks): Objective test consisting of English Language, Engineering Discipline (Paper I & II), General Intelligence and Reasoning. The examination is tentatively scheduled for 06 June 2026.

Language Proficiency Test (LPT): Candidates provisionally selected from the online examination will have to undergo a Language Proficiency Test in the Official/Local Language/s of the zone concerned. Candidate not proficient in the Official/Local Language/s would be disqualified.

Document Verification & Medical Examination: Final selection will be on the basis of performance in the online examination (in order of merit), qualifying in LPT, medical fitness and verification of certificates to the Bank's satisfaction.

RBI Junior Engineer (Civil/ Electrical) Recruitment 2026 Documents Required

Candidates must upload the following at the time of online application:

Recent passport size photograph, Signature, Left Thumb Impression, Hand-written declaration (in English) as per specifications given in the notification.

Note: At the time of LPT / Document Verification, candidates will be required to produce original documents related to age, educational qualification, experience, category, PwBD, Ex-Servicemen etc. as applicable.

Photo & Signature: Scanned as per exact specifications (Photograph: 20-50 KB, Signature: 10-20 KB, Left Thumb Impression: 20-50 KB, Hand-written Declaration: 50-100 KB).

Sl. No. Category Fee
01 SC / ST / PwBD / EXS ₹50/- + 18% GST (Intimation Charges only)
02 OBC / General / EWS ₹450/- + 18% GST (Examination Fee + Intimation Charges)

Fee can be paid online via Debit Card / Credit Card / Internet Banking / IMPS / Cash Cards / Mobile Wallets. Staff candidates are exempted from payment of fee/intimation charges. Bank transaction charges will have to be borne by the candidate. Fee once paid will not be refunded.

How to Apply for RBI Junior Engineer (Civil/ Electrical) Recruitment 2026

Eligible candidates for RBI Junior Engineer Recruitment 2026 must submit their application online through the official website www.rbi.org.in within the specified last date. The online application process is as follows:

Step 1 - Registration: Visit the Bank's website www.rbi.org.in and click on the link "Recruitment for the Post of Junior Engineer (Civil/ Electrical) - Panel Year 2026". Choose "Click here for New Registration" and enter basic details. A Provisional Registration Number and Password will be generated. Upload scanned photograph, signature, left thumb impression and handwritten declaration as per specifications.

Step 2 - Application Submission: Login with Provisional Registration Number and Password. Fill all required details in the online application form. Validate the details and save the application using "SAVE AND NEXT" facility. Upload required images and preview the entire form before final submission.

Step 3 - Final Submission & Fee Payment: After verifying all entries, click on "COMPLETE REGISTRATION". Proceed to payment of applicable fee/intimation charges online. On successful payment, an e-Receipt will be generated. Download and print the final submitted application form for future reference.

Edit Window: After the closing date, a short Edit Window (dates to be notified) will be available for limited corrections (Exam Centre, Father's Name, Mother's Name) on payment of ₹200/- correction fee.

Note: Candidates can apply only for one post and one zone. Offline applications will not be accepted. Incomplete applications or applications without proper photograph/signature will be rejected. Candidates are advised to apply well before the last date to avoid last-minute technical issues.

Bank of Baroda Sportspersons Recruitment 2026 Vacancy Details

A total of 30 vacancies have been announced across 4 sports disciplines - Cricket, Kabaddi, Table Tennis, and Football - spread across posting locations in Delhi, Mumbai, and Chennai. Out of 30 posts, 24 are for Male candidates and 6 for Female candidates.

Each vacancy carries a specific role/specialisation requirement (e.g., Batsman, Fast Bowler, Goalkeeper, Midfielder, etc.), and candidates must ensure they apply only for the role matching their sports specialisation. The Bank reserves the right to modify the number of vacancies and their breakup as per its requirement. There is no reservation for SC/ST/OBC/EWS categories in this recruitment.

Bank of Baroda Sportspersons Recruitment 2026 Application Fee

The application fee is non-refundable and must be paid online at the time of registration regardless of whether the candidate is shortlisted for Field Trials or not. General, EWS, and OBC candidates are required to pay ₹850/- (inclusive of GST) plus applicable payment gateway charges. SC, ST, ESM/DESM (Ex-Servicemen/Disabled Ex-Servicemen), and Women candidates are required to pay ₹175/- (intimation charges only, inclusive of GST) plus applicable payment gateway charges.

Payment can be made through Debit Card, Credit Card, Internet Banking, UPI, or any other available online payment mode. Transaction charges, if any, are to be borne by the candidate. Once fee payment is completed successfully, an e-receipt and application form will be generated, which should be printed and retained. The Bank will not entertain any refund requests under any circumstances.

Bank of Baroda Sportspersons Recruitment 2026 Pay Scale & Benefits

Selected candidates will be placed in the clerical cadre pay scale as applicable to Customer Service Associates in Bank of Baroda. The starting basic pay is ₹24,050/- per month and the scale progresses through multiple incremental stages over a period of 20 years, reaching up to ₹64,480/-. Increments are applied at different rates at various stages of the pay scale as detailed below.

Bank of Baroda Sportspersons Recruitment 2026 Selection Process

The selection process consists of two main stages: Shortlisting/Screening of applications followed by Field Trials for shortlisted candidates. In the first stage, applications will be screened against the eligibility criteria including educational qualifications, relevant sports experience, domain expertise, and suitability. Meeting the minimum eligibility criteria does not automatically entitle a candidate to be called for Field Trials - the Bank may call candidates in a ratio as deemed appropriate at its sole discretion. The shortlisting criteria are internal and confidential and will not be shared with candidates.

Shortlisted candidates will be called for Field Trials at a designated venue, the evaluation criteria and qualifying cut-off for which will be determined solely by the Bank. No requests for change of centre, venue, date, or time for Field Trials will be entertained. The Bank's decision on shortlisting and selection at all stages is final and binding. Selected candidates must be Active Sportspersons at the time of joining and fit enough to participate in future tournaments. All selected sportspersons will be required to sign a written undertaking to play for the Bank's team whenever required.

Stage Details
Stage 1: Shortlisting / Screening Applications screened based on eligibility criteria, sports experience, qualifications, and suitability as determined by the Bank. Criteria are internal and confidential.
Stage 2: Field Trials Shortlisted candidates called for Field Trials at designated venue. Evaluation criteria and qualifying cut-off determined solely by the Bank.
Stage 3: Document Verification Original documents to be produced at the time of Field Trials / as called by the Bank. Failure to produce documents will debar candidature.

Obligations of Candidates Recruited as Sportspersons

Obligation Details
Playing for the Bank Sportsperson must play for the Bank / Bank's team whenever and wherever necessary.
Permission for External Events Prior permission required to participate in State / National / International events for other organisations. Bank reserves the right to withhold permission.
Misconduct Refusal to play for the Bank or playing elsewhere without permission will be treated as misconduct and attract disciplinary proceedings.
Written Undertaking All recruited sportspersons must give a written undertaking at the time of appointment.

How to Apply for Bank of Baroda Sportspersons Recruitment 2026

The application process is entirely online - no other mode of application will be accepted. Candidates must visit the Bank's official website www.bankofbaroda.bank.in and apply through the Careers → Current Opportunities section. Before starting the application, candidates must ensure they have a valid personal email ID and active mobile number, a scanned passport-size photograph (20–50 KB, JPG format), a scanned signature in black ink on white paper (10–20 KB, JPG format), and scanned PDF copies of all required documents within the specified file sizes (maximum 500 KB per file).

Candidates are advised to fill the application with utmost care as no changes will be permitted after clicking the SUBMIT button. All details including name, caste, category, date of birth, mobile number, and email ID will be treated as final. Candidates must not submit more than one application; in case of multiple submissions, only the last valid completed application will be retained and fees for earlier applications will be forfeited. A printout of the system-generated application form and e-receipt should be retained for future reference.

  • Visit: www.bankofbaroda.bank.in → Careers → Current Opportunities
  • Register online and fill the application form carefully in all fields.
  • Upload scanned photograph, signature, and all required documents as per specifications in Annexure I.
  • Pay the application fee online via Debit Card / Credit Card / Internet Banking / UPI.
  • On successful payment, download and retain the e-receipt and application form printout.
  • Produce original documents at the time of Field Trials as per the document list in Section 10.4 of the notification.

Important Instructions for Candidates

Candidates must read the full official notification carefully before filling the application. All eligibility criteria are to be met as on the cut-off date of 01.04.2026. Change of category is not permitted at any stage after submission of the online application. Candidates should not furnish false, fabricated, or tampered information at any stage - doing so will result in disqualification or termination even after joining. Any canvassing or creating undue influence will lead to disqualification. All legal proceedings arising from this recruitment can only be instituted at courts in Mumbai. Signatures must remain consistent across all documents and correspondence throughout the recruitment process. Selected candidates will be governed by the Bank's service conditions including provisions related to probation (6 months), confirmation, disciplinary rules, and execution of service bonds. Candidates with adverse credit history, criminal cases, or adverse reports from CIBIL or other credit agencies will be ineligible. The Bank reserves the right to reject, modify, increase/decrease vacancies, or cancel the recruitment process at any stage without assigning any reason.

  • Online application once submitted cannot be modified. Fill with utmost care.
  • Keep email ID and mobile number active till completion of the recruitment process.
  • No request for change of Field Trial centre, venue, date or time will be entertained.
  • Maintain a minimum CIBIL score of 680 at the time of joining.
  • Probation period is 6 months from the date of joining.
  • All announcements / corrigendum will be posted only on the Bank's official website.
  • No separate communication will be sent to candidates who are not shortlisted or not selected.

MPSC Recruitment 2026 Notification Overview

The Maharashtra Public Service Commission (MPSC) has officially released a recruitment notification for State Tax Inspector, Police Sub-Inspector and More. For all details regarding the recruitment process, eligibility, and application procedure, refer to the official notification. Eligible candidates can download it from the link below.

Maharashtra Public Service Commission (MPSC)

Advt No 011/2026

State Tax Inspector, Police Sub-Inspector and More Vacancy 2026

WWW.FREEJOBALERT.COM

Download Mobile App

Application Fee

  • For General (Open) Category: Rs. 394
  • For Backward Class / Anath / Divyang: Rs. 294
  • For Ex-Serviceman (General): Rs. 394
  • For Ex-Serviceman (Backward Class / Anath / Divyang): Rs. 294
  • Bank charges and applicable taxes are extra, in addition to the above examination fee.
  • The examination fee is Non-Refundable. 
  • Online Payment Mode: Credit Card, Debit Card, or Net Banking through any payment gateway provided by Indian State Bank or other banks
  • Offline Mode (Challan): Fee can be paid through challan at any branch of Indian State Bank. 

MPSC Recruitment 2026 Important Dates

  • Notification Date: 09-04-2026
  • Starting Date for Apply Online: 10-04-2026
  • Last Date for Apply Online: 30-04-2026
  • Last Date for Online Examination Fee Payment: 30-04-2026
  • Last Date for Fee Payment through Indian State Bank Challan: 02-05-2026
  • Last Date for Challan Payment at Bank Branch: 04-05-2026
  • Date of Combined Pre-Examination: 14-06-2026

MPSC Recruitment 2026 Age Limit

  • Assistant Section Officer: 18 - 38 Years
  • State Tax Inspector: 18 - 38 Years
  • Police Sub-Inspector: 19 - 31 Years
  • Age relaxation is applicable as per rules.

Eligibility Criteria

Educational Qualification

  • Degree of a Statutory University or any other qualification declared equivalent by the Government.
  • Candidates appearing in their final year degree examination are eligible to apply for the Combined Pre-Examination; however, they must pass their degree examination by the last date for accepting applications for the Main Examination of the concerned post.
  • If the post requires an internship or work experience, the candidate must have completed such internship or work experience by the last date for accepting applications for the Main Examination. 
  • Knowledge of Marathi language is required.

Physical Standards (for Police Sub-Inspector only)

  • Male Candidates (General/Third Gender):
    • Height: Minimum 165 cm (relaxation applicable)
    • Chest: Minimum expansion of 5 cm required; unexpanded minimum 79 cm
  • Female Candidates (General/Third Gender):
    • Height: Minimum 150 cm (relaxation applicable)
  • Candidates not meeting the physical standards shall be declared unfit for appointment.
  • The required educational qualification must be held up to the last date of accepting applications for the Main Examination or equivalent.

Nationality

  • Indian Citizenship is required

Salary

  • Assistant Section Officer (Group-B Non-Gazetted): Pay Band S-16 – Rs. 48,900 – 1,42,400 per month plus additional allowances as per rules.
  • State Tax Inspector & Other Posts (S-14): Pay Band S-14 – Rs. 38,600 – 1,22,800 per month plus additional allowances as per rules.

MPSC Maharashtra Group-B Combined Pre-Examination 2026 Vacancy Details

Post Name Total
Assistant Section Officer, Group-B (Non-Gazetted) - Maharashtra Public Service Commission 06
State Tax Inspector, Group-B (Non-Gazetted) 236

Selection Process

  • Stage 1 – Combined Pre-Examination (Samyukt Purva Pariksha): All three posts share a common preliminary examination. The pre-exam carries 100 marks.
  • Stage 2 – Main Examination (Mukhya Pariksha): Candidates shortlisted from the Combined Pre-Examination are eligible to appear for the Main Examination of the respective post. The Main Examination carries 400 marks for Maharashtra Group-B (Non-Gazetted) Combined Service Main Examination.
  • Stage 3 – Physical Test (for Police Sub-Inspector only): Physical endurance test of 100 marks is conducted. Qualifying marks: minimum 60 out of 100 (i.e., 60 marks). Candidates scoring below 60 marks are not eligible for interview/further process. Candidates scoring below 60 marks will also not be considered for final selection.
  • The final result will be declared based on the combined merit of the Main Examination marks and Physical Test marks (for Police Sub-Inspector). 
  • The examination type and process for each post shall follow the service entry rules as below:
    • Assistant Section Officer, Group-B (Non-Gazetted) Service Entry Rules 2018.
    • State Tax Inspector (Tax Collector Inspector) Group-B (Non-Gazetted) Service Entry Rules 2021.
    • Police Sub-Inspector, Group-B (Non-Gazetted) Service Entry Rules 1995.
  • The final result process for the Combined Pre-Examination and Main Examination shall be as per the present Examination Scheme / Method published on the Commission's website. 

How to Apply

  • Applications are accepted only through the Commission's Online Application System at https://mpsconline.gov.in. 
  • Step 1 (One): If you have not previously registered on the Commission's Online Application Portal, create a new Profile (Account) and register. If you already have an account, log in and update your profile if necessary.
  • Step 2 (Two): Ensure your account is active and complete KYC verification through the Commission's portal before applying.
  • Step 3 (Three): Complete the KYC (Know Your Customer) process on the Commission's website. The KYC process must be completed as per official Advt. No. ADR-2425/SER.06/2025/MA.TAN. published on 20 June 2025, within the valid period available in the account. The KYC process in the account must be completed independently. 
  • Step 4 (Four): Upload required documents (as applicable) in PDF format within the prescribed file size limits (minimum 50 KB, maximum 500 KB per file)
  • Step 5 (Five): Pay the examination fee online (Credit Card, Debit Card, Net Banking) or offline (Challan at Indian State Bank branch).
  • Step 6 (Six): Select the district examination centre.
  • Step 7 (Seven): As per the Combined Pre-Examination notification, candidates must apply online via the Commission's Computer System for the Maharashtra Group-B (Non-Gazetted) Combined Pre-Examination. 
  • Step 8 (Eight): Based on the Reserved and Unreserved total vacancy count from the Combined Pre-Examination, the number of candidates eligible for the Main Examination will be determined, and a combined merit result of Maharashtra Group-B (Non-Gazetted) service candidates will be declared. 
  • Admit Cards for the examination will be made available on the Commission's Online Application Portal (https://mpsconline.gov.in) 7 days before the examination date. Download the Admit Card and produce it at the examination centre.
  • The Admit Card cannot be issued to candidates themselves; it must be downloaded by the candidate from the Commission portal. 
  • After the Admit Card is made available, the candidate's registered mobile number will receive an SMS notification

General Information / Instructions

  • There are a total of 37 district examination centres across Maharashtra for this examination. (Page 1)
  • Candidates who pass the Combined Pre-Examination and qualify for the Main Examination shall declare the Main Examination date themselves.
  • Applications are accepted only through the Commission's Online Application System. 
  • Application portal: https://mpsconline.gov.in and also available at https://mpsc.gov.in. 
  • Applications will not be considered without payment of the prescribed examination fee
  • KYC verification through the Commission's portal (Advt. No. ADR-2425/SER.06/2025/MA.TAN., dated 20 June 2025) must be completed within the prescribed period before applying. 
  • Candidates who claim Economically Weaker Section (EWS) reservation must upload the income/asset certificate for the year 2025–2026 or 2026–2027 by the last acceptance date (30 April 2026). 
  • Candidates who claim Sports Quota reservation must upload the Sports Certificate (Government Decision dated 01 July 2016) along with the application before the deadline. 
  • Divyang (PWD) candidates must upload valid UDID Card (Universal Identification Card) and relevant disability certificate
  • If the Sports Certificate submitted along with the application is not available, or if the document submitted on or before the prescribed date was not complete/valid, then the Sports Reservation claim shall not be accepted. 
  • Candidates must select a district examination centre at the time of applying. Once a district centre is chosen, it cannot be changed under any circumstances.
  • The following documents must be uploaded by reserved category candidates at the time of applying
    • Proof of Social Category (Caste Certificate) – PDF, Min 50 KB, Max 500 KB
    • Economically Weaker Section certificate for year 2025–2026 or 2026–2027 – PDF
    • Valid Non-Creamy Layer Certificate for year 2025–2026 or 2026–2027 – PDF
    • Proof of eligible PWD/Divyang status – PDF
    • Proof of Ex-Serviceman status – PDF
    • Sports Quota Eligibility proof (for Pre-Exam: Sports Proof of Sports Participation Report or Sports Proof document submission record as applicable) – PDF
    • Proof of Anath (Orphan) Reservation eligibility – PDF
    • Domicile Proof for Backward Class, Divyang, Ex-Serviceman, Anath reservation claim – PDF
  • After appointment, selected candidates must have the following educational/professional qualifications:
    • Where departmental/professional examination is compulsory, the candidate must pass such examination as per departmental norms.
    • Hindi and Marathi language proficiency examinations as per applicable rules. 
    • Computer literacy certificate/proof as per Government Resolution (GR) dated 04 February 2013 (Maharashtra IT GR) and revised GR dated 01 July 2016. 
  • Use of mobile phone or any electronic device at the exam hall, examination venue, physical test, or interview venue is strictly prohibited.
  • Candidates must submit all original documents at the time of document verification; failure to do so will render them ineligible for selection/appointment. 
  • This notification is available on the Commission's website: https://mpsc.gov.in and https://mpsconline.gov.in.

NPCIL Executive Trainee Recruitment 2026 – Eligibility Criteria

Educational Qualification: B.E./B.Tech/B.Sc. (Engineering) or 5-year Integrated M.Tech with a minimum of 60% aggregate marks in one of the 6 advertised disciplines from a university/institution recognised by AICTE/UGC. Only full-time, on-campus regular degrees are eligible — correspondence, distance education, part-time, and research-based degrees are not accepted.

GATE Score: Candidates must hold a valid GATE 2024, GATE 2025, or GATE 2026 score in the same discipline as their qualifying degree. GATE 2023 and earlier scores are not valid. Equal weightage is given to all three years' GATE scores.

Fee is payable online only via debit card, credit card, net banking, or UPI through the integrated payment gateway. No other mode accepted.

NPCIL Executive Trainee Recruitment 2026 – Selection Process

Candidates are shortlisted for Personal Interview based on GATE 2024/2025/2026 scores in a 1:12 ratio (discipline and category wise). GATE score carries no weightage in the final selection — final selection is purely based on Personal Interview performance and medical fitness.

Stage Details
Shortlisting Based on GATE 2024/2025/2026 score (1:12 ratio, merit list discipline & category wise)
Personal Interview Tentatively 8–19 June 2026 at Mumbai, NAPS (UP), MAPS (Tamil Nadu), KGS (Karnataka)
Qualifying marks (Interview) UR — 70% | EWS/SC/ST/OBC(NCL)/PwBD — 60%
Tie-breaking Higher GATE score → if still tied, senior in age ranks higher
Medical fitness Mandatory — by NPCIL's authorised medical officer
Bond Rs. 9,18,000/- indemnity bond + service bond for minimum 3 years after training

NPCIL Executive Trainee Recruitment 2026 – Training Details

Selected candidates undergo a one-year orientation training at one of NPCIL's Nuclear Training Centres (NTC). Candidates in Mechanical, Chemical, Electrical, Electronics, and Instrumentation disciplines must choose a Reactor Stream — either Pressurised Heavy Water Reactor (PHWR) or Light Water Reactor (LWR). Civil discipline candidates need not indicate a reactor stream preference. After successful training completion, candidates are appointed as Scientific Officer/C in Group A on a one-year probation.

How to Apply for NPCIL Executive Trainee Recruitment 2026

1. Register: Visit www.npcilcareers.co.in and click Apply → Online Registration. Enter your GATE registration number (from GATE 2024/2025/2026 admit card), discipline, personal details, and category. An activation link will be sent to your registered email.

2. Activate your account: Click the activation link in your email to activate your login.

3. Fill application form: Log in and complete all stages — educational qualifications, post-qualification work experience (if any), personal details, interview city preference, reactor stream choice (if applicable), and upload scanned photo (JPEG, max 50 KB) and signature (JPEG, max 20 KB).

4. Submit application: Review the draft carefully and click "Submit Application." No changes can be made after submission.

5. Pay application fee (if applicable): General/EWS/OBC male candidates pay Rs. 500/- online via debit/credit card, net banking, or UPI. Fee payment window: 10 April – 30 April 2026. Note your application number on successful payment.
